P-QF01-COMMON-CI-20261109-003 — 共通CIの版整合・修正版

状態：PROPOSED。今回承認を求めるのは、固定した16パスの技術補修です。二次関数QF01の作成は承認を維持して待機中です。

問題と今回の修正

P002で承認された15パスは、実適用前に停止しました。旧W038の生成記録2件では、IDの集合が同じでも走査順が変わります。元の適用ガードはIDと順序の一致を要求します。Mが最初に比較したbeforeはパッチ済みscratchで、正確なGit原本との順序比較が不足していました。この確認漏れと拒否証拠を保存しました。P002の実Work開始・正式patch適用はありません。

今回、その旧JSON2件の更新を撤回し、元のバイト列を保存します。旧生成器を「現行データの検査専用」に変更し、現在の生成結果を新Workの別の証拠として照合します。加えて、後続で確認したシミュレーションfixtureの旧保護値と、N08画面検査の旧版固定を修正します。承認済みの残り13パスは同じ差分を引き継ぎます。合計は既存14＋新規fixture2＝16パスです。

承認範囲

対象はrrikunagasige-dot/kyotsu-step-web、repository ID1391122224、source cd64eea4c5edb15f0f0cb4d43c89a4795e192ab0。既存の独立補修branch work/qf01-common-ci-repair-20261109、draft PR141で実施します。新Work W-TECH-QF01-CI-EDITION-P003-20261109はtechnical/CMD-WORK-001、実在する親W-MATH-QF01-BUILD-20261109へ接続し、既存CI補修issueを関連付けます。未開始P002 Workをnative親にしません。

この承認は以下の固定16パス、専用Work記録、原APIによる入力登録・claim・適用・CI・draft更新を対象とします。共通CIがすべて成功した場合だけ、既承認のQF feature branchへCAS照合のうえ統合し、新しいsourceに対する四幅検査・C09・G2へ進みます。main統合・本番公開・本人受入を、この技術補修の承認から推定しません。

製品src332ファイルは現在の原本と全件一致しています。製品UI・教材・進捗保存・stable ID・原文PDFを変更しません。元Runtime/adapter・定義・保護ガード・CI YAML・依存は変更しません。workflow/test_legacy_diagnostics.pyはテストファイルだけです。旧承認・旧PLAN・旧FAILも保存します。

13パスの引継ぎ

9つのE2Eと2つのテスト専用入口・データを版に結び付けます。歴史的Pageと依存はcommit171c04781f32c1286a0762905891b582714834f9の原本を機械的にbundleし、現在の製品へprivate exportやtestidを追加しません。旧16-unit、カタログ4項目・65判断は凍結fixtureで検証し、通常の製品入口は現行3項目・168判断を別に検証します。途中の138という誤った推定は修正済みで、旧記録も残しています。NE01/NE02を省いて旧版を装いません。

元の775 expect呼出し・callback・timeoutと136個の固定解答tupleを保持します。skipや成功条件の削減はしません。通常入口には誤答→正答・reload・reset・SET/物理への移動などの現行動作検査を追加します。残り2パスは旧N11保護値を版で照合するtool testとW039 release manifestです。W039は旧N11の組又は既承認の現行組だけを認め、混在は拒否します。無制限のhash更新を許しません。

1. W038 materialize.mjs：旧PLAN/MATH_CHECKの2hashを厳密に保持し、既承認の現行N11 IR、派生PLAN・数学検査・実製品JSONを厳密に照合します。通常の書込みは停止します。--proofのときだけ新Work/activation/W038_CURRENT_DERIVATION.jsonへ決定的な証拠を書きます。未知の入力、混在版、生成内容の差、引数なし・未知flagを拒否します。旧原本の再演を現行生成器で合格扱いにはしません。

2. workflow/test_legacy_diagnostics.py：シミュレーション内の計画コピーについて、従来のsource_manifestと同様にprotected_manifestを現行fixture入力へ固定します。歴史的な承認や本番保護値は変更しません。元の古い保護値を戻す負例では、元Runtimeが開始前に拒否し台帳イベント0件となることも検証します。

承認後の手順と停止条件

Mだけが正式Store/Git writerです。A・Bの2名は担当制作と非作者レビュー、孫なし。実承認文・本HTML hash・固定patch digestを記録し、接続先本人/owner/repo/branch/live HEADを再照合します。入力18件（変更16＋保存旧記録2）を正確に固定し、原APIで新Workを開きます。既存ファイルは実Git-before、新2fixtureは明示した未接続入力を登録します。旧2JSONは読み取り専用です。現在のNative台帳9591/head d05dc6fb659e9f7f08ab341e53a588f006b84b5cde512ad94e2eb9a3ca2d67eeから復旧し、未開始P002を開始済みと扱いません。

原adapterで固定16パスを一度適用し、差分・原本不変・CODE・対象検査と全該当CIを実行します。残る失敗は原因と版を保存し、同一範囲なら修正・再検査、新範囲なら修正提案へ戻します。FAILを解消済みにせず、対象から検査を落としません。

親QF保護373件のうち、前案P001で承認適用された旧test8件の差分を元guardが検出しています。残365件は不変です。親へ進む時は元のbundle/source/rulesを維持して、その8件だけを正式reviseし、再fingerprint・新CODE/C08/C09/G2を通します。旧失敗をPASSに書き換えません。

async function answer(page: Page, id: string, value: string) {
  const trigger = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + id)
  await expect(trigger).toBeVisible()
  if (id.startsWith('n12-p002-') || (id.startsWith('n12-p003-') && id !== 'n12-p003-q10-meaning' && id !== 'n12-p003-q10-box-fee')) {
    await expect(trigger).toHaveClass(/reading-formula-choice--token/)
    await expect(trigger).toContainText(/選択|×/)
  }
  await trigger.click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + id)
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: value, exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + id)).toBeVisible()
}

test('N12 P-003: 35 progressive inline holes, math, figure gates, retry and reload', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(150_000)
  await page.goto(path)
  await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('n12-restart-top')).toBeVisible()
  expect(choices).toHaveLength(35);
  const f01 = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n12-f01')
  const f02 = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n12-f02')
  const f03 = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n12-f03')
  await expect(f01).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(f02).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(f03).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-01')).toHaveCount(0)

  // Visual-only W-MATH-006/P-001: N02-style label/border, retained 44px touch target.
  const firstToken = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-coef')
  await expect(firstToken).toHaveText('選択')
  const tokenBox = await firstToken.boundingBox()
  expect(tokenBox?.width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(44)
  expect(tokenBox?.height).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(44)
  const tokenBorder = await firstToken.evaluate((element) => {
    const style = getComputedStyle(element)
    return { radius: style.borderRadius, top: style.borderTopWidth }
  })
  expect(tokenBorder).toEqual({ radius: '0px', top: '1px' })
  await firstToken.focus()
  await expect(firstToken).toBeFocused()

  // Wrong coefficient: cannot unlock either the next local constant or original final question.
  await page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-coef').click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-n12-p002-q01-coef')
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
  const displayedOptions = panel.locator('.reading-choice-option')
  let wrongClicked = false
  for (let i = 0; i < await displayedOptions.count(); i += 1) {
    const option = displayedOptions.nth(i)
    if (await option.getAttribute('aria-label') === '2') continue
    await option.click()
    wrongClicked = true
    break
  }
  expect(wrongClicked).toBe(true)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-p002-q01-coef')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-const')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-01')).toHaveCount(0)

  for (const [id, value] of choices) {
    await answer(page, id, value)
    if (id === 'n12-p002-q01-coef' || id === 'n12-p002-q02-coef') {
      // Coefficients other than 1 must remain explicit before x.
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + id).locator('.katex-html')).toHaveText('2')
    }
    if (id === 'n12-p002-q02-const') {
      // A numeric answer 1 at the end of an expression must remain 1.
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-p002-q02-const').locator('.katex-html')).toHaveText('1')
    }
    if (id === 'n12-p002-q06-left-coef') {
      // W-MATH-007: retain answer "1" internally, but the rendered formula reads x+2, never 1x.
      const solved = page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-p002-q06-left-coef')
      await expect(solved.locator('.katex-html')).toHaveText('x')
      await expect(solved).toHaveAttribute('aria-label', '係数は1（式ではx）')
      const visibleParts = await page
        .getByTestId('textbook-formula-formula-q06-left-coef')
        .locator('.katex-html').allInnerTexts()
      const visibleFormula = visibleParts.join('').replace(/\s+/g, '')
      expect(visibleFormula).toContain('x+2')
      expect(visibleFormula).not.toContain('1x')
      expect(visibleFormula).not.toContain('xx+2')
      const savedAnswer = await page.evaluate(() =>
        JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kyotsu-step-store') || '{}')
          .state.textbookProgress['math-numbers-expressions-n12']
          .answers['n12-p002-q06-left-coef'].value,
      )
      expect(savedAnswer).toBe('1')
    }
    if (id === 'n12-p002-q06-right-coef') {
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-p002-q06-right-coef').locator('.katex-html')).toHaveText('3')
    }
    if (id === 'n12-02') {
      await expect(f01).toBeVisible()
      await expect(f02).toHaveCount(0)
    }
    if (id === 'n12-06') {
      await expect(f02).toBeVisible()
      await expect(f03).toHaveCount(0)
    }
    if (id === 'n12-14') await expect(f03).toHaveCount(0)
    if (id === 'n12-15') {
      await expect(f03).toBeVisible()
      await expect(f03.locator('img')).toHaveJSProperty('complete', true)
    }
    await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
    const overflowing = await page.locator('.reading-formula-line--n12').evaluateAll(lines =>
      lines.filter(line => line.scrollWidth > line.clientWidth + 2)
        .map(line => line.getAttribute('data-testid')),
    )
    expect(overflowing, 'No inner formula horizontal scrollbar').toEqual([])
  }

  for (const derivation of ['solve-first', 'solve-second', 'triple-solve', 'cost-range']) {
    await expect(page.locator('[data-derivation-id="' + derivation + '"]')).toHaveCount(1)
  }
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()

  // Approved W-MATH-008/P-001 visual contract: all three phone widths,
  // including every formula's *internal* scroll (document-only is insufficient).
  for (const width of [320, 375, 390]) {
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 760 })
    const overflow = await page.locator('.reading-formula-line--n12').evaluateAll(lines =>
      lines.filter(line => line.scrollWidth > line.clientWidth + 2)
        .map(line => line.getAttribute('data-testid')),
    )
    expect(overflow, `N12 formula overflow at ${width}px`).toEqual([])
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth))
      .toBeLessThanOrEqual(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.clientWidth + 1))
    await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
  }
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-p002-q01-coef')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-p002-q06-left-coef').locator('.katex-html')).toHaveText('x')
  await expect(f03).toBeVisible()
})

test('N12 P-003: v1 history is archived and a genuine restart begins at Q01', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(path)
  await page.evaluate(() => {
    localStorage.clear()
    const record = (id: string, value: string) => ({
      itemId: id, value, firstValue: value, isFirstCorrect: true, resolved: true,
      attemptCount: 1, firstAnsweredAt: 100, lastAnsweredAt: 200,
    })
    const progress = {
      unitId: 'math-numbers-expressions-n12', unitRevision: 1,
      startedAt: 100, updatedAt: 200, completedAt: 250,
      answers: {
        'n12-01': record('n12-01', 'x>-\\frac72'),
        'n12-01a': record('n12-01a', '-7<2x'),
      },
    }
    localStorage.setItem('kyotsu-step-store', JSON.stringify({
      state: { textbookProgress: { [progress.unitId]: progress } }, version: 1,
    }))
  })
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('n12-progress-upgrade-note')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-coef')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-01')).toHaveCount(0)

  await answer(page, 'n12-p002-q01-coef', '2')
  await answer(page, 'n12-p002-q01-const', '-7')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-01')).toBeVisible()
  await answer(page, 'n12-01', 'x>-\\frac72')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q02-coef')).toBeVisible()

  const saved = await page.evaluate(() => {
    const state = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kyotsu-step-store') || '{}').state
    return state.textbookProgress['math-numbers-expressions-n12']
  })
  expect(saved.unitRevision).toBe(3)
  expect(saved.migratedFromRevision).toBe(1)
  expect(saved.previousRevisionCompletedAt).toBe(250)
  expect(saved.completedAt).toBeUndefined()
  expect(saved.archivedRevisions['1'].answers['n12-01'].value).toBe('x>-\\frac72')
  expect(saved.archivedRevisions['1'].answers['n12-01a'].value).toBe('-7<2x')
  expect(saved.answers['n12-p002-q01-coef'].value).toBe('2')
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-01')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q02-coef')).toBeVisible()

  page.once('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())
  await page.getByTestId('n12-restart-top').click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-coef')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n12-01')).toHaveCount(0)
  const afterReset = await page.evaluate(() =>
    JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kyotsu-step-store') || '{}').state
      .textbookProgress['math-numbers-expressions-n12'],
  )
  expect(afterReset.unitRevision).toBe(3)
  expect(afterReset.answers).toEqual({})
  expect(afterReset.archivedRevisions['1']).toEqual(saved.archivedRevisions['1'])
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-coef')).toBeVisible()
})

test('N12 current r4: ordinary route,46 decisions,15 stages,wrong gate,completion and reload', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(150_000)
  await page.goto('/kyotsu-step-web/#/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-n12')
  await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
  await page.reload()
  expect(currentR4).toHaveLength(46)
  expect(new Set(currentR4.map(row => row.stage)).size).toBe(15)
  // The ordinary entry loads App lazily; await actual reader bootstrap, not the HTML loading shell.
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
  await expect(page.getByTestId('math-textbook-stage-n12-stage-01')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('guided-source-question')).toContainText('同時に満たす')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-coef')).toHaveCount(0)
  const first = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-q01-subtract-x')
  await first.click()
  const firstPanel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-n12-q01-subtract-x')
  await firstPanel.getByRole('button', { name: '2', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-hint-n12-q01-subtract-x')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('[data-block-id="n12-q01-subtract-x-equation"]')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-p002-q01-coef')).toHaveCount(0)
  let stage = currentR4[0].stage as string
  let transitions = 0
  for (const row of currentR4) {
    if (row.stage !== stage) {
      await expect(page.getByTestId('math-textbook-next-stage')).toBeVisible()
      await page.getByTestId('math-textbook-next-stage').click()
      stage = row.stage
      transitions += 1
    }
    await expect(page.getByTestId('math-textbook-stage-' + row.stage)).toBeVisible()
    await page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + row.id).click()
    await page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + row.id).getByRole('button', { name: row.answer, exact: true }).click()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + row.id)).toHaveCount(0)
    for (const blockId of row.afterIds) {
      await expect(page.locator('[data-block-id="' + blockId + '"]')).toBeVisible()
    }
    await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
  }
  expect(transitions).toBe(14)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('n12-complete')).toBeVisible()
  const saved = await page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kyotsu-step-store') || '{}').state.textbookProgress['math-numbers-expressions-n12'])
  expect(saved.unitRevision).toBe(4)
  expect(Object.keys(saved.answers)).toHaveLength(46)
  expect(saved.answers['n12-q01-subtract-x'].attemptCount).toBe(2)
  expect(saved.completedAt).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
  await expect(page.getByTestId('n12-complete')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('[data-block-id="n12-15-equation"]')).toBeVisible()
  page.once('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'この単元を最初から', exact: true }).first().click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-q01-subtract-x')).toBeVisible()
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kyotsu-step-store') || '{}').state.textbookProgress['math-numbers-expressions-n12'])).toBeUndefined()
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n12-q01-subtract-x')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
})
e2e/math-textbook-set-smoke.spec.ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'

const appRoute = (path: string) => path.startsWith('/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-')
  ? editionHistoricalRoute(path) : `/kyotsu-step-web/#${path}`

async function clearState(page: Page) {
  await page.goto(appRoute('/problems'))
  await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
  await page.reload()
}

async function chooseWrongOption(page: Page, itemId: string, correctLabel: string) {
  await page.getByTestId(`textbook-item-${itemId}`).click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId(`inline-choice-panel-${itemId}`)
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible()

  const options = panel.locator('.reading-choice-option')
  for (let index = 0; index < await options.count(); index += 1) {
    const option = options.nth(index)
    const label = (await option.getAttribute('aria-label')) ?? ''
    if (label !== correctLabel) {
      await option.click()
      return
    }
  }
  throw new Error(`No distractor visible for ${itemId}`)
}


async function advanceMathStage(page: Page) {
  const button = page.getByTestId('math-textbook-next-stage')
  await expect(button).toBeVisible()
  await button.click()
}

async function answerItem(page: Page, itemId: string, answer: string) {
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible()
  const target = page.getByTestId(`textbook-item-${itemId}`)
  // Review-only units have the original renderer and must NEVER inherit math-sets
  // navigation. Only this published math-sets pilot has explicit "次へ" stages.
  if (await page.getByTestId('math-textbook-compact-flow').count()) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 20 && await target.count() === 0; i += 1) {
      await advanceMathStage(page)
    }
  }
  await expect(target).toBeVisible()
  await target.click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId(`inline-choice-panel-${itemId}`)
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: answer, exact: true }).click()
}

test('W-MATH-010 N02 zero-coefficient term is an after-answer explanation, not a leaked coefficient', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 720 })
  await clearState(page)
  await page.goto(appRoute('/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-n02'))
  for (const [id, answer] of [
    ['n02-01', '3bx'],
    ['n02-02', 'x^3-ax^2+3bx+5c'],
    ['n02-03', '(2y-3,\\ y^2-3y+2)'],
    ['n02-04', 'x^2+(2y-3)x+(y^2-3y+2)'],
  ] as const) await answerItem(page, id, answer)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-05'))
    .toHaveAttribute('aria-label', '係数が0の一次項を、Bの式中に補おう。')
  await expect(page.getByText('もとの式の値は変わらない。')).toHaveCount(0)
  await chooseWrongOption(page, 'n02-05', '0x')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-06')).toHaveCount(0)
  await answerItem(page, 'n02-05', '0x')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n02-05')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByText('もとの式の値は変わらない。')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-06')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
  const viewport = await page.evaluate(() => ({width: document.documentElement.clientWidth, scroll: document.documentElement.scrollWidth}))
  expect(viewport.scroll).toBeLessThanOrEqual(viewport.width + 1)
})

test('proposition-reading follows the textbook order from truth to necessary/sufficient to negation', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(appRoute('/learning/textbook/math-propositions-reading'))

  await expect(page.getByTestId('reading-role-example-marker-example-implication')).toBeVisible()

  const truthAnswers: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['prop-a01', '満たす'],
    ['prop-a02', 'すべて入る'],
    ['prop-a03', '-1'],
    ['prop-a04', '偽'],
    ['prop-a05', '-3'],
    ['prop-a07', '直角二等辺三角形'],
  ]
  for (const [itemId, answer] of truthAnswers) await answerItem(page, itemId, answer)

  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-a06')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-a08')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByText(/この命題は偽である/)).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('reading-role-check-marker-check-counterexample')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('.reading-term').filter({ hasText: /^反例$/ })).toBeVisible()

  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '2つの条件の関係を見る', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('reading-role-example-marker-example-necessary-sufficient')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-b01')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-equal-diagonals-quadrilateral')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-c01')).toHaveCount(0)

  await answerItem(page, 'prop-b01', '等しい')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-equal-diagonals-quadrilateral')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-b02')).toBeVisible()

  const relationAnswers: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['prop-b02', '限らない'],
    ['prop-b04', '必要条件'],
    ['prop-b05', 'どちらも真'],
  ]
  for (const [itemId, answer] of relationAnswers) await answerItem(page, itemId, answer)

  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-b03')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-b06')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.getByText(/必要十分条件であり、2つの条件は同値である/)).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('.reading-term').filter({ hasText: /^十分条件$/ })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('.reading-term').filter({ hasText: /^必要条件$/ })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('.reading-term').filter({ hasText: /^必要十分条件$/ })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.locator('.reading-term').filter({ hasText: /^同値$/ })).toBeVisible()

  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '成り立たない条件を考える', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('reading-role-example-marker-example-negation')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-c01')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-c01')).toHaveAttribute(
    'aria-label',
    /成り立たない条件/,
  )
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-prop-c01')).not.toHaveAttribute(
    'aria-label',
    /否定/,
  )

  const negationAnswers: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['prop-c01', 'n\\ge2'],
    ['prop-c02', '2は合成数ではない'],
    ['prop-c03', 'a\\ge0\\text{ または }b\\le0'],
    ['prop-c04', '-1<x<3'],
  ]
  for (const [itemId, answer] of negationAnswers) await answerItem(page, itemId, answer)

  await expect(page.getByTestId('reading-role-summary-marker-summary-proposition-reading')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-next-unit')).toHaveAttribute(
    'href',
    /\/learning\/textbook\/math-quantifiers-all-exists$/,
  )
  await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)

  const viewport = await page.evaluate(() => ({
    clientWidth: document.documentElement.clientWidth,
    scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
  }))
  expect(viewport.scrollWidth).toBeLessThanOrEqual(viewport.clientWidth + 1)
})

test('proof review reaches contrapositive and contradiction conclusions without layout regressions', async ({ page }) => {

    ['proof-a04', '偽'],
    ['proof-a04r', '真'],
    ['proof-a04i', '真'],
    ['proof-a05', '偽'],
    ['proof-a06', '真'],
    ['proof-a07', 'n=6'],
    ['proof-a08', '真'],
    ['proof-b00', '対偶'],
    ['proof-b01', 'nが3の倍数でない ⇒ n²が3の倍数でない'],
    ['proof-b02', '1または2'],
    ['proof-b03', '3(3k^2+2k)+1'],
    ['proof-b04', '3の倍数にならない'],
    ['proof-b05', '真である'],
    ['proof-c00', 'x\\ne0'],
    ['proof-c01', '\\sqrt2=-\\frac{\\sqrt3y}{x}'],
    ['proof-c01b', '\\sqrt6=-\\frac{3y}{x}'],
    ['proof-c02', '有理数'],
    ['proof-c03', '矛盾する'],

test('P-004 all eleven existing math-set SVG assets load and decode under production base', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(appRoute('/learning/textbook/math-sets'))
  const names = [
    'venn-two-blank.svg', 'venn-intersection.svg', 'venn-union.svg',
    'subset-after.svg', 'complement-after.svg',
    'demorgan-intersection-complement.svg', 'demorgan-union-complement.svg',
    'number-line-a.svg', 'number-line-b.svg', 'number-line-abar.svg', 'number-line-bbar.svg',
  ]
  const results = await page.evaluate(async (files: string[]) => {
    return await Promise.all(files.map(async name => {
      const src = '/kyotsu-step-web/assets/math/textbook/sets/' + name
      return await new Promise<{ name: string, loaded: boolean, width: number, height: number, path: string }>((resolve) => {
        const img = new Image()
        img.onload = () => resolve({ name, loaded: true, width: img.naturalWidth, height: img.naturalHeight, path: new URL(img.src).pathname })
        img.onerror = () => resolve({ name, loaded: false, width: 0, height: 0, path: new URL(img.src).pathname })
        img.src = src
      })
    }))
  }, names)
  expect(results).toHaveLength(11)
  for (const item of results) {
    expect(item.path, item.name).toBe('/kyotsu-step-web/assets/math/textbook/sets/' + item.name)
    expect(item.loaded, item.name).toBe(true)
    expect(item.width, item.name).toBeGreaterThan(0)
    expect(item.height, item.name).toBeGreaterThan(0)
  }
})

    ['n10-16', '\\frac{\\sqrt3}{6}'],

e2e/numbers-next-batch.spec.ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'

const route = (unitId: string) => editionHistoricalRoute('/learning/textbook/' + unitId)

async function visitClean(page: Page, unitId: string) {
  await page.goto(route(unitId))
  await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
  await page.reload()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible()
}

async function choose(page: Page, id: string, answer: string) {
  const trigger = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + id)
  await expect(trigger).toBeVisible()
  await trigger.click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + id)
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: answer, exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + id)).toBeVisible()
}

async function mobileLayoutCheck(page: Page) {
  await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
  const viewport = await page.evaluate(() => ({
    content: document.documentElement.scrollWidth,
    client: document.documentElement.clientWidth,
  }))
  expect(viewport.content).toBeLessThanOrEqual(viewport.client + 1)
}

test('N02 review: all 12 source-stage decisions, compound answers, no forward leakage', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 720 })
  await visitClean(page, 'math-numbers-expressions-n02')
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '式を整える', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-current-topic')).toContainText('多項式の整理と加減')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-01')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-02')).toHaveCount(0)
  const answers: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['n02-01','3bx'],
    ['n02-02','x^3-ax^2+3bx+5c'],
    ['n02-03','(2y-3,\\ y^2-3y+2)'],
    ['n02-04','x^2+(2y-3)x+(y^2-3y+2)'],
    ['n02-05','0x'],
    ['n02-06','x^3-x^2+x+1'],
    ['n02-07','x^3-2x^2-2'],
    ['n02-08','3x^3-5x^2+x-3'],
    ['n02-09','(4x^3-6x^2+2x-2,\\ 3x^3-6x^2-6)'],
    ['n02-10','7x^3-12x^2+2x-8'],
    ['n02-11','2A-3B'],
    ['n02-12','7x^3-12x^2+2x-8'],
  ]
  for (const [id, answer] of answers) {
    await choose(page, id, answer)

  await mobileLayoutCheck(page)
  await page.reload()

})

test('N09 review: n=-3 gates original figure, all 14 original plus 4 square decisions and negative fractional parts', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 720 })

  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '実数を扱う', exact: true })).toBeVisible()

  const first: Array<[string, string]> = [

    ['n09-04','(a,\\ -a)'],
    ['n09-05','|a|'],

  const last: Array<[string, string]> = [
    ['n09-11','-3+0.9'],
    ['n09-12','3<\\sqrt{10}<4'],
    ['n09-13','-4<-\\sqrt{10}<-3'],
    ['n09-14','\\begin{aligned}\\sqrt{10}&:(3,\\sqrt{10}-3)\\\\-\\sqrt{10}&:(-4,4-\\sqrt{10})\\end{aligned}'],
  ]
  for (const [id, answer] of last) await choose(page, id, answer)
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
  await mobileLayoutCheck(page)
  await page.reload()
  await expect(originalFigure).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
})

e2e/r3-local-token.spec.ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'
import editionData from './fixtures/historical-math-data.json' with { type: 'json' }
import { validateTextbookUnits as editionValidate } from '../src/domain/textbookSchema'

const editionUnits = editionValidate(editionData.units)
const mathNumbersN01Unit = editionUnits.find(unit => unit.unitId === 'math-numbers-expressions-n01')!
const mathNumbersN03Unit = editionUnits.find(unit => unit.unitId === 'math-numbers-expressions-n03')!
const n01SourceToItemIds = editionData.sourceMaps.n01
const n03SourceToItemIds = editionData.sourceMaps.n03

const route = (unitId: string) => editionHistoricalRoute('/learning/textbook/' + unitId)
const cases = [
  { unit: mathNumbersN01Unit, source: n01SourceToItemIds, tokens: [
    ['n01-r3-q07-x2coef', '-2'], ['n01-r3-q07-xcoef', '-3'], ['n01-r3-q07-const', '3'],
  ], figure: null },
  { unit: mathNumbersN03Unit, source: n03SourceToItemIds, tokens: [
    ['n03-r3-q10-p1', '6x^2'], ['n03-r3-q10-p2', '8x'],
    ['n03-r3-q10-p3', '3x'], ['n03-r3-q10-p4', '4'],
  ], figure: 'n03-f01' },
] as const

async function solve(page: Page, id: string, answer: string) {
  const trigger = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + id)
  await expect(trigger).toBeVisible()
  await expect(trigger).toHaveClass(/reading-formula-choice--token/)
  await expect(trigger).toContainText(/選択|×/)
  // W-MATH-006/P-001: approved visual-only unification with the original N02 rectangle.
  const metrics = await trigger.evaluate((element) => {
    const style = getComputedStyle(element)
    const bounds = element.getBoundingClientRect()
    return { width: bounds.width, height: bounds.height, radius: style.borderRadius, border: style.borderTopWidth }
  })
  expect(metrics.width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(44)
  expect(metrics.height).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(44)
  expect(metrics.radius).toBe('0px')
  expect(metrics.border).toBe('1px')
  await trigger.click()
  const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + id)
  await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
  await panel.getByRole('button', { name: answer, exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + id)).toBeVisible()
}

for (const { unit, source, tokens, figure } of cases) {
  test(unit.unitId + ': full old-v1 completion migrates, seven-hole P-002 scope remains gated, and reload is safe', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(100_000)
    await page.goto(route(unit.unitId))
    const allOldIds = Object.values(source).flat()
    const records = Object.fromEntries(allOldIds.map(id => {
      const item = unit.sections[0].items.find(candidate => candidate.id === id)!
      return [id, {
        itemId: id, value: item.answer, firstValue: item.answer, isFirstCorrect: true,
        resolved: true, attemptCount: 3, firstAnsweredAt: 100, lastAnsweredAt: 200,
      }]
    }))
    const seed = {
      unitId: unit.unitId, unitRevision: 1,
      startedAt: 100, updatedAt: 200, completedAt: 300, answers: records,
    }
    await page.evaluate((oldState) => {
      localStorage.clear()
      localStorage.setItem('kyotsu-step-store', JSON.stringify({
        state: { textbookProgress: { [oldState.unitId]: oldState } }, version: 1,
      }))
    }, seed)
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('r3-progress-upgrade-note')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + tokens[0][0])).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + tokens[1][0])).toHaveCount(0)

    if (unit.unitId === 'math-numbers-expressions-n03') {
      // Previously unverified narrow-mobile risk: 320/375/390px before answering.
      for (const width of [320, 375, 390]) {
        await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 820 })
        await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + tokens[0][0])).toBeVisible()
        const widths = await page.evaluate(() => [
          document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        ])
        expect(widths[0], 'N03 page-level overflow at viewport ' + width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(widths[1] + 1)
      }
    }

    await page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + tokens[0][0]).click()
    const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + tokens[0][0])
    const options = panel.locator('.reading-choice-option')
    let wrongClicked = false
    for (let i = 0; i < await options.count(); i++) {
      const option = options.nth(i)
      if (await option.getAttribute('aria-label') === tokens[0][1]) continue
      await option.click()
      wrongClicked = true
      break
    }
    expect(wrongClicked).toBe(true)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + tokens[0][0])).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + tokens[1][0])).toHaveCount(0)

    for (const [id, answer] of tokens) {
      await solve(page, id, answer)
      await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
    }
    if (unit.unitId === 'math-numbers-expressions-n03') {
      for (const width of [320, 375, 390]) {
        await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 820 })
        const widths = await page.evaluate(() => [
          document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        ])
        expect(widths[0], 'N03 solved page-level overflow at ' + width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(widths[1] + 1)
      }
    }
    if (figure) {
      const img = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-' + figure)
      await expect(img).toBeVisible()
      await expect(img.locator('img')).toHaveJSProperty('complete', true)
    }
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
    expect(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth))
      .toBeLessThanOrEqual(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.clientWidth + 1))

    const persisted = await page.evaluate(id => JSON.parse(
      localStorage.getItem('kyotsu-step-store') || '{}',
    ).state?.textbookProgress?.[id], unit.unitId)
    expect(persisted.unitRevision).toBe(2)
    expect(persisted.migratedFromRevision).toBe(1)
    expect(persisted.previousRevisionCompletedAt).toBe(300)
    expect(persisted.completedAt).toBeDefined()
    for (const id of allOldIds) {
      expect(persisted.answers[id].attemptCount).toBe(3)
      expect(persisted.answers[id].value).toBe(records[id].value)
    }
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + tokens[0][0])).toBeVisible()
  })
}

  }
  return '/kyotsu-step-web/e2e/fixtures/historical-math.html#' + path
}
e2e/numbers-catalog-publish.spec.ts
import { expect, test, type Page } from '@playwright/test'
import editionData from './fixtures/historical-math-data.json' with { type: 'json' }

const appRoute = (path: string) => /^\[archive171c\] /.test(test.info().title)
  ? editionHistoricalRoute(path) : '/kyotsu-step-web/#' + path

test.beforeEach(async ({ page }) => {
  await page.goto(appRoute('/learning/setup?subject=math-1a'))
  await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
  await page.reload()
})

test('[archive171c] chapter 1 has three core and one optional reachable review topics; chapter 3 and physics remain intact', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.setViewportSize({ width: 320, height: 720 })
  const chapter1 = page.getByTestId('math-textbook-chapter-1')
  await expect(chapter1).toContainText('数と式')
  const labels = [
    ['numbers-polynomials', '式を整える', 'math-numbers-expressions-n01'],
    ['numbers-real', '実数を扱う', 'math-numbers-expressions-n07'],
    ['numbers-inequalities', '不等式を使う', 'math-numbers-expressions-n11'],
    ['numbers-development', '参考・発展', 'math-numbers-expressions-ne01'],
  ] as const
  const links = chapter1.locator('a[data-testid^="math-textbook-topic-"]')
  await expect(links).toHaveCount(4)
  for (const [topic, title, firstUnit] of labels) {
    const link = page.getByTestId('math-textbook-topic-' + topic)
    await expect(link).toContainText(title)
    await expect(link).toContainText('レビュー公開中')
    await expect(link).not.toContainText('準備中')
    await expect(link).toHaveAttribute('href', '#/learning/textbook/' + firstUnit)
  }
  await expect(page.getByTestId('math-textbook-chapter-3')).toContainText('集合と命題')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('math-textbook-topic-organize-sets')).toHaveAttribute('href', '#/learning/textbook/math-sets')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('math-textbook-topic-read-propositions')).toContainText('準備中')
  const width = await page.evaluate(() => [document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth])
  expect(width[0]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(width[1] + 1)
  await page.getByRole('button', { name: '物理', exact: true }).click()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-part-1')).toBeVisible()
})

test('[archive171c] theme navigation and stable N02/N09 deep links show the real source lessons', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.getByTestId('math-textbook-topic-numbers-real').click()
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/learning\/textbook\/math-numbers-expressions-n07$/)
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '実数を扱う', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-current-topic')).toContainText('分数と小数で、同じ数を表す')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n07-01')).toBeVisible()

  await page.goto(appRoute('/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-n09'))
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n09-01')).toBeVisible()

  await page.goto(appRoute('/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-n02'))
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: '式を整える', exact: true })).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-current-topic')).toContainText('多項式の整理と加減')
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-01')).toBeVisible()
  await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n02-02')).toHaveCount(0)
  await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
})

test('[archive171c] chapter 1 keeps learner progress and shows unfinished topic on return', async ({ page }) => {
  await page.getByTestId('math-textbook-topic-numbers-real').click()
  await page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n07-01').click()
  await page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-n07-01').getByRole('button', { name: '0.75（小数第2位で終了）', exact: true }).click()

})


// Explicit archival compatibility entry; original test assertions remain unchanged.
function editionHistoricalRoute(path: string) {
  if (!test.info().annotations.some(item => item.type === 'historical-edition')) {
    test.info().annotations.push({ type: 'historical-edition', description: '171c archival Page + pinned shared runtime; not current Page coverage' })
  }
  return '/kyotsu-step-web/e2e/fixtures/historical-math.html#' + path
}


// Separate actual-current-entry smoke for every affected family. These checks never
// enter the historical fixture and do not reuse historical answer/renderer aliases.
type EditionCurrentContract = {
  code: string; unitId: string; revision: number; title: string; kind: string
  firstId?: string; nextId?: string; control?: string; reopenAfterWrong?: boolean; resetMode?: string
  nodeId?: string; partId?: string; partKey?: string; nextPartKey?: string; compiledHash?: string
  answer: string; wrong: string
}
const editionCurrentContracts = editionData.currentContracts as EditionCurrentContract[]

async function editionMainProgress(page: Page, unitId: string) {
  return page.evaluate(id => JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('kyotsu-step-store') || '{}').state?.textbookProgress?.[id], unitId)
}

for (const contract of editionCurrentContracts.filter(item => item.code !== 'n12')) {
  test('Current ordinary route ' + contract.code + ': accepted edition, wrong gate, answer, reload and reset', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(90_000)
    test.info().annotations.push({ type: 'actual-current-entry', description: 'cd64 accepted production route; first interaction smoke, not full-unit replay' })
    await page.goto('/kyotsu-step-web/#/learning/textbook/' + contract.unitId)
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-current-topic')).toContainText(contract.title)
    expect(page.url()).not.toContain('/fixtures/')
    if (contract.kind === 'nested') {
      const reader = page.getByTestId('n0910-revision-page')
      await expect(reader).toHaveAttribute('data-revision', String(contract.revision))
      await expect(reader).toHaveAttribute('data-compiled-hash', contract.compiledHash!)
      const first = page.locator('[data-node-id="' + contract.nodeId + '"] [data-part-key="' + contract.partKey + '"]')
      const nextEditable = page.locator('[data-node-id="' + contract.nodeId + '"] [data-part-key="' + contract.nextPartKey + '"][data-editable="true"]')
      await expect(first).toHaveAttribute('data-slot-state', 'initial')
      await first.click()
      const panel = page.locator('[data-active-part-id="' + contract.partId + '"]')
      await panel.getByRole('button', { name: contract.wrong, exact: true }).click()
      await expect(first).toHaveAttribute('data-slot-state', 'wrong')
      await expect(nextEditable).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(panel.getByRole('status')).toBeVisible()
      await panel.getByRole('button', { name: contract.answer, exact: true }).click()
      // Certified parts are substituted into the completed math, so their controls disappear.
      await expect(first).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(nextEditable).toBeVisible()
      const saved = await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)
      expect(saved.unitRevision).toBe(contract.revision)
      expect(saved.nestedProgress.records[contract.partId!].value).toBe(contract.answer)
      expect(saved.nestedProgress.records[contract.partId!].firstValue).toBe(contract.wrong)
      expect(saved.nestedProgress.records[contract.partId!].selectionCount).toBe(2)
      await page.reload()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
      await expect(first).toHaveCount(0)
      await expect(nextEditable).toBeVisible()
      expect((await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)).nestedProgress.records[contract.partId!]).toEqual(saved.nestedProgress.records[contract.partId!])
      page.once('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'この単元を最初から', exact: true }).first().click()
      await expect(first).toHaveAttribute('data-slot-state', 'initial')
      expect((await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)).nestedProgress.records[contract.partId!]).toBeUndefined()
    } else {
      const target = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + contract.firstId)
      const first = contract.control === 'child-button' ? target.getByRole('button') : target
      const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + contract.firstId)
      await expect(first).toBeVisible()
      await first.click()
      await panel.getByRole('button', { name: contract.wrong, exact: true }).click()
      if (contract.reopenAfterWrong) await first.click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-hint-' + contract.firstId)).toBeVisible()
      expect((await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)).answers[contract.firstId!].resolved).toBe(false)
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + contract.nextId)).toHaveCount(0)
      await panel.getByRole('button', { name: contract.answer, exact: true }).click()
      const saved = await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)
      expect(saved.unitRevision).toBe(contract.revision)
      expect(saved.answers[contract.firstId!].value).toBe(contract.answer)
      expect(saved.answers[contract.firstId!].firstValue).toBe(contract.wrong)
      expect(saved.answers[contract.firstId!].resolved).toBe(true)
      expect(saved.answers[contract.firstId!].attemptCount).toBe(2)
      await expect(target).toHaveCount(0)
      await page.reload()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
      expect((await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)).answers[contract.firstId!]).toEqual(saved.answers[contract.firstId!])
      await expect(target).toHaveCount(0)
      page.once('dialog', dialog => dialog.accept())
      await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'この単元を最初から', exact: true }).first().click()
      await expect(first).toBeVisible()
      const reset = await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)
      if (contract.resetMode === 'empty-and-archive') {
        expect(reset.answers).toEqual({})
        expect(Object.values(reset.archivedRevisions).some(archive => { const record = archive as { answers: Record<string, { value: string }> }; return record.answers[contract.firstId!]?.value === contract.answer })).toBe(true)
      } else expect(reset).toBeUndefined()
    }
    await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible({ timeout: 30_000 })
    const reset = await editionMainProgress(page, contract.unitId)
    if (contract.kind === 'nested') expect(reset.nestedProgress.records[contract.partId!]).toBeUndefined()
    else if (contract.resetMode === 'empty-and-archive') expect(reset.answers).toEqual({})
    else expect(reset).toBeUndefined()
  })
}

// Current catalogue is an independent ordinary-route contract: 36+30+32+40+30=168.
// The unchanged historical 1/65 assertion above remains an archival data contract.

e2e/new-batch-walkthrough.spec.ts
import { mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'
import editionData from './fixtures/historical-math-data.json' with { type: 'json' }
import { validateTextbookUnits as editionValidate } from '../src/domain/textbookSchema'

const mathTextbookUnits = editionValidate(editionData.units)

const units = ['04', '05', '06', '07', '08', '11', '13', '14'] as const
const route = (n: string) => editionHistoricalRoute('/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-n' + n)

for (const n of units) {
  test('W-MATH-003 batch N' + n + ': all original choices, mobile/PC progression, persistence and figures', async ({ page }, testInfo) => {
    test.setTimeout(180_000)
    const unit = mathTextbookUnits.find(u => u.unitId.endsWith('n' + n))!
    const items = unit.sections[0].items
    const figureIds = unit.sections[0].figures.map(f => f.id)
    await page.goto(route(n))
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + items[0].id)).toBeVisible()
    const evidence = process.env.E2E_BATCH_EVIDENCE === '1'
    const device = testInfo.project.name.includes('mobile') ? 'mobile' : 'desktop'
    const pictured = new Set<string>()
    async function captureFigureWhenUnlocked() {
      for (const fig of figureIds) {
        if (pictured.has(fig)) continue
        const locator = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-' + fig)
        if (await locator.count() === 0) continue
        await expect(locator).toBeVisible()
        pictured.add(fig)
        if (evidence) {
          await locator.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
          await page.screenshot({ path: 'e2e-evidence/n' + n + '-figure-' + fig + '-' + device + '.png', fullPage: false })
        }
      }
    }
    for (const fig of figureIds) {
      const locator = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-' + fig)
      if (fig === 'n08-f01' || fig === 'n11-f01') await expect(locator).toBeVisible()
      else await expect(locator).toHaveCount(0)
    }
    await captureFigureWhenUnlocked()

    for (const [i, item] of items.entries()) {
      const trigger = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + item.id)
      await expect(trigger, item.id).toBeVisible()
      await trigger.click()
      const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + item.id)
      await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
      if (evidence && (i === 0 || i === Math.floor(items.length / 2))) {
        await trigger.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
        await page.screenshot({ path: 'e2e-evidence/n' + n + '-' + (i === 0 ? 'start' : 'middle') + '-' + device + '.png', fullPage: false })
      }
      await panel.getByRole('button', { name: item.answer, exact: true }).click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + item.id)).toBeVisible()
      await captureFigureWhenUnlocked()
      await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
      if (i + 1 < items.length) await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + items[i + 1].id)).toBeVisible()
    }
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
    for (const fig of figureIds) {
      const image = page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-' + fig).locator('img')
      await expect(image).toBeVisible()
      expect(await image.evaluate((img: HTMLImageElement) => img.complete && img.naturalWidth > 0), fig).toBe(true)
    }
    if (evidence) await page.screenshot({ path: 'e2e-evidence/n' + n + '-finish-' + device + '.png', fullPage: false })
    const width = await page.evaluate(() => [document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth])
    expect(width[0], 'document horizontal overflow').toBeLessThanOrEqual(width[1] + 2)
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + items[0].id)).toBeVisible()
  })
}


// W-MATH-014/P-001 — original N14 Q07: two sign-case thinking decisions
// plus the unchanged original final four-choice interval. Actual screenshots
// are written only when the existing native evidence workflow enables it.
for(const width of [320,390]){
  test('W-MATH-014 N14 Q07 sign-case proof, wrong/hint/retry and persisted choices at '+width+'px',
    async({page},testInfo)=>{
      test.skip(testInfo.project.name!=='mobile-chromium','Capture once per requested viewport')
      test.setTimeout(240_000)
      await page.setViewportSize({width,height:850})
      const unit=mathTextbookUnits.find(u=>u.unitId.endsWith('n14'))!
      const items=unit.sections[0].items
      const ids=['n14-wm014-q07-nonnegative','n14-wm014-q07-negative','n14-07']
      expect(unit.revision).toBe(10) // Q16 P-001 adds 4 decisions; all earlier accepted steps unchanged
      expect(items.slice(6,9).map(i=>i.id)).toEqual(ids)
      await page.goto('/kyotsu-step-web/#/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-n14')
      await page.evaluate(()=>localStorage.clear())
      await page.reload()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible()
      for(const item of items.slice(0,6)){
        const trigger=page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+item.id)
        await expect(trigger,item.id).toBeVisible()
        await trigger.click()
        const panel=page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+item.id)
        await panel.getByRole('button',{name:item.answer,exact:true}).click()
        await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+item.id)).toBeVisible()
      }
      const evidence=process.env.E2E_BATCH_EVIDENCE==='1'
      if(evidence)mkdirSync('e2e-evidence',{recursive:true})
      for(const id of ids){
        const item=items.find(z=>z.id===id)!
        const trigger=page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+id)
        await expect(trigger).toBeVisible()
        await trigger.click()
        let panel=page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+id)
        await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
        const correct=panel.getByRole('button',{name:item.answer,exact:true})
        await expect(correct).toBeVisible()
        const correctID=await correct.getAttribute('data-testid')
        for(const option of await panel.locator('.reading-choice-option').all())
          for(const line of await option.locator('.reading-choice-formula-line').all()){
            const dimensions=await line.evaluate(node=>[node.scrollWidth,node.clientWidth])
            expect(dimensions[0],id+' choice clipping').toBeLessThanOrEqual(dimensions[1]+1)
          }
        if(evidence){
          await trigger.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
          await page.screenshot({path:'e2e-evidence/wmath014-'+id+'-'+width+'-before.png'})
        }
        const options=await panel.getByRole('button').all()
        let wrong:(typeof options)[number]|undefined
        for(const option of options){
          if((await option.getAttribute('data-testid'))!==correctID){wrong=option;break}
        }
        expect(wrong).toBeDefined()
        await wrong!.click()
        await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toHaveCount(0)
        await trigger.click()
        panel=page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+id)
        await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-hint-'+id)).toBeVisible()
        if(evidence)await page.screenshot({
          path:'e2e-evidence/wmath014-'+id+'-'+width+'-wrong.png',
        })
        await panel.getByRole('button',{name:item.answer,exact:true}).click()
        await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
        await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
        const bounds=await page.evaluate(()=>[
          document.documentElement.scrollWidth,document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        ])
        expect(bounds[0],id+' horizontal overflow').toBeLessThanOrEqual(bounds[1]+2)
        if(evidence)await page.screenshot({
          path:'e2e-evidence/wmath014-'+id+'-'+width+'-resolved.png',
        })
      }
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n14-wm015-q08-nonnegative')).toBeVisible()
      await page.reload()
      for(const id of ids)await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n14-f01')).toBeVisible()
    })
}

          for(const line of await option.locator('.reading-choice-formula-line').all()){
            const widths=await line.evaluate(node=>[node.scrollWidth,node.clientWidth])
            expect(widths[0],id+' choice overflow').toBeLessThanOrEqual(widths[1]+1)
          }
        if(evidence){
          await trigger.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
          await page.screenshot({path:'e2e-evidence/wmath015-'+id+'-'+width+'-before.png'})
        }
        const choices=await panel.getByRole('button').all()
        let wrong:(typeof choices)[number]|undefined
        for(const choice of choices){
          if((await choice.getAttribute('data-testid'))!==rightKey){wrong=choice;break}
        }
        expect(wrong).toBeDefined()
        await wrong!.click()
        await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toHaveCount(0)
        await trigger.click()
        panel=page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+id)
        await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-hint-'+id)).toBeVisible()
        if(evidence)await page.screenshot({
          path:'e2e-evidence/wmath015-'+id+'-'+width+'-wrong.png',
        })
        await panel.getByRole('button',{name:item.answer,exact:true}).click()
        await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
        await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
        const bounds=await page.evaluate(()=>[
          document.documentElement.scrollWidth,document.documentElement.clientWidth,
        ])
        expect(bounds[0],id+' page overflow').toBeLessThanOrEqual(bounds[1]+2)
        if(evidence)await page.screenshot({
          path:'e2e-evidence/wmath015-'+id+'-'+width+'-resolved.png',
        })
      }
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n14-09')).toBeVisible()
      await page.reload()
      for(const id of ids)await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n14-07')).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n14-f01')).toBeVisible()
    })
}

// W-MATH-019/P-001: independent real-browser Q14 check in an already-approved
// math E2E workflow. Never infer formula fit from document scrollWidth only.
for(const width of [320,390,1440] as const){
  test('W-MATH-019/Q14 narrow real Chromium '+width, async({page},info)=>{
    test.skip(width===1440?info.project.name!=='desktop-chromium':info.project.name!=='mobile-chromium')
    test.setTimeout(240_000)
    await page.setViewportSize({width,height:width===1440?1000:850})
    const unit=mathTextbookUnits.find(u=>u.unitId.endsWith('n14'))!
    const ids=['n14-wm019-q14-add-left','n14-wm019-q14-add-center','n14-wm019-q14-add-right','n14-14','n14-wm019-q14-bound-right']
    const items=unit.sections[0].items
    const first=items.findIndex(i=>i.id===ids[0])
    expect(first).toBeGreaterThan(20)
    await page.goto(route('14'))
    await page.evaluate(()=>localStorage.clear())
    await page.reload()
    const answer=async(id:string,value:string)=>{
      const button=page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+id)
      await expect(button,id).toBeVisible()
      await button.click()
      await page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+id).getByRole('button',{name:value,exact:true}).click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
    }
    for(const prior of items.slice(0,first)) await answer(prior.id,prior.answer)
    const line=page.getByTestId('textbook-formula-n14-formula-14')
    const chain=page.locator('[data-derivation-id="n14-q14-chain"]')
    const reason=chain.locator('.reading-derivation-step--paragraph')
    await expect(line).toBeVisible()
    await expect(reason).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(chain.locator('.reading-formula-line')).toHaveCount(2)
    const measure=async()=>{
      const m=await line.evaluate(el=>{
        const b=el.getBoundingClientRect()
        const e=el.querySelector('.reading-formula-expression') as HTMLElement
        const parts=Array.from(e.children).map(k=>{const r=k.getBoundingClientRect();return {left:r.left,right:r.right,top:r.top}})
        const buttons=Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button.reading-formula-choice')).map(k=>{
          const s=getComputedStyle(k),r=k.getBoundingClientRect()
          return {text:k.textContent?.trim(),w:r.width,h:r.height,minw:parseFloat(s.minWidth),minh:parseFloat(s.minHeight),
            label:k.getAttribute('aria-label'),color:s.color,borderColor:s.borderColor}
        })
        return {scrollWidth:el.scrollWidth,clientWidth:el.clientWidth,left:b.left,right:b.right,
          display:getComputedStyle(e).display,parts,buttons}
      })
      expect(m.parts).toHaveLength(6)
      expect(m.scrollWidth,'N14 Q14 formula clips internally at '+width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(m.clientWidth+1)
      for(const p of m.parts){
        expect(p.left,'N14 Q14 left clip '+width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(m.left-1)
        expect(p.right,'N14 Q14 right clip '+width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(m.right+1)
      }
      for(const b of m.buttons){
        expect(['選択','×']).toContain(b.text)
        expect(b.label).toBeTruthy()
        expect(b.w).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(b.minw-1)
        expect(b.h).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(b.minh-1)
        expect(b.color).toBe(b.borderColor)
      }
      if(width<=430){
        expect(m.display).toBe('grid')
        expect(Math.min(...m.parts.slice(4).map(k=>k.top))-Math.min(...m.parts.slice(0,4).map(k=>k.top))).toBeGreaterThan(12)
      }else expect(m.display).toBe('flex')
      return m
    }
    for(const [i,id] of ids.entries()){
      const item=items.find(k=>k.id===id)!
      await page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+id).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
      if(i<3){
        await measure()
        await expect(reason).toHaveCount(0)
        await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n14-14')).toHaveCount(0)
      }else await expect(reason).toHaveCount(1)
      const button=page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+id)
      await button.focus()
      await button.press('Enter')
      const panel=page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+id)
      const opts=await panel.getByRole('button').all()
      const right=panel.getByRole('button',{name:item.answer,exact:true})
      const rightId=await right.getAttribute('data-testid')
      let bad:(typeof opts)[number]|undefined
      for(const opt of opts)if((await opt.getAttribute('data-testid'))!==rightId){bad=opt;break}
      expect(bad).toBeDefined()
      await bad!.click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toHaveCount(0)
      await button.click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-hint-'+id)).toBeVisible()
      await panel.getByRole('button',{name:item.answer,exact:true}).click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
      if(i===2){
        await expect(reason).toHaveCount(1)
        await expect(reason.first()).toContainText('中央の−2と＋2')
      }
      if(i!==4) await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n14-15')).toHaveCount(0)
    }
    // W-MATH-020: Q15 opens with three division choices before its re-keyed left bound.
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n14-wm020-q15-divide-left')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n14-15')).toHaveCount(0)
    await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
    const v=await page.evaluate(()=>[document.documentElement.scrollWidth,document.documentElement.clientWidth])
    expect(v[0]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(v[1]+2)
    await page.reload()
    for(const id of ids)await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n14-10')).toBeVisible()
  })
}


// W-MATH-022/P-001: Q16 must actually be solved in five local decisions,
// with genuine 320/390/1440 rendering, wrong-hint-retry and saved progress.
// The former combined Q16 answer MUST NOT be accepted as new progress.
for (const width of [320, 390, 1440] as const) {
  test('W-MATH-022 N14 Q16 five-step endpoint check in Chromium '+width, async ({page}, info) => {
    test.skip(width === 1440
      ? info.project.name !== 'desktop-chromium'
      : info.project.name !== 'mobile-chromium')
    test.setTimeout(240_000)
    await page.setViewportSize({width, height: width === 1440 ? 1000 : 850})
    const unit=mathTextbookUnits.find(u=>u.unitId.endsWith('n14'))!
    const items=unit.sections[0].items
    const q16Ids=[
      'n14-wm022-q16-left-inner','n14-wm022-q16-left-abs',
      'n14-wm022-q16-right-inner','n14-wm022-q16-right-abs','n14-16',
    ]
    expect(unit.revision).toBe(10)
    expect(items).toHaveLength(38)
    const start=items.findIndex(i=>i.id===q16Ids[0])
    expect(start).toBe(33)
    expect(items.slice(start).map(i=>i.id)).toEqual(q16Ids)
    await page.goto(route('14'))
    await page.evaluate(()=>localStorage.clear())
    await page.reload()
    const solve=async(id:string,value:string)=>{
      const button=page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+id)
      await expect(button,id).toBeVisible()
      await button.click()
      await page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+id).getByRole('button',{name:value,exact:true}).click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
    }
    for (const prior of items.slice(0,start)) await solve(prior.id,prior.answer)
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+q16Ids[0])).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('n14-after-16')).toHaveCount(0)
    const evidence=process.env.E2E_BATCH_EVIDENCE==='1'
    if (evidence) mkdirSync('e2e-evidence',{recursive:true})
    const lineIds=['n14-formula-16','n14-wm022-q16-right']
    const measure=async()=>{
      for (const id of lineIds) {
        const target=page.getByTestId('textbook-formula-'+id)
        if(await target.count()===0)continue
        const m=await target.evaluate(el=>{
          const r=el.getBoundingClientRect()
          const e=el.querySelector('.reading-formula-expression') as HTMLElement
          const parts=Array.from(e.children).map(p=>{
            const a=p.getBoundingClientRect()
            return {left:a.left,right:a.right,top:a.top}
          })
          const buttons=Array.from(el.querySelectorAll('button.reading-formula-choice')).map(b=>{
            const rect=b.getBoundingClientRect(),style=getComputedStyle(b)
            return {text:b.textContent?.trim(),w:rect.width,h:rect.height,minw:parseFloat(style.minWidth),minh:parseFloat(style.minHeight)}
          })
          return {left:r.left,right:r.right,scroll:el.scrollWidth,client:el.clientWidth,
            display:getComputedStyle(e).display,parts,buttons}
        })
        expect(m.parts,id).toHaveLength(5)
        expect(m.scroll,'Q16 horizontal clipping '+id+' at '+width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(m.client+1)
        for (const part of m.parts){
          expect(part.left,id+' left clip at '+width).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(m.left-1)
          expect(part.right,id+' right clip at '+width).toBeLessThanOrEqual(m.right+1)
        }
        for(const b of m.buttons){
          expect(['選択','×']).toContain(b.text)
          expect(b.w).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(b.minw-1)
          expect(b.h).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(b.minh-1)
        }
        if(width<=430){
          expect(m.display).toBe('grid')
          expect(m.parts[1].top-m.parts[0].top).toBeGreaterThan(12)
        }else expect(m.display).toBe('flex')
      }
    }
    for(const [index,id] of q16Ids.entries()){
      const q=items.find(z=>z.id===id)!
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+id)).toBeVisible()
      if(index<4) await measure()
      const button=page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+id)
      await button.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
      if(evidence && (index===0 || index===2 || index===4))
        await page.screenshot({path:'e2e-evidence/wmath022-q16-'+width+'-step'+(index+1)+'-before.png'})
      await button.focus()
      await button.press('Enter')
      const panel=page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-'+id)
      await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
      const wrong=q.choices!.find(c=>c!==q.answer)!
      await panel.getByRole('button',{name:wrong,exact:true}).click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toHaveCount(0)
      await button.click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-hint-'+id)).toBeVisible()
      if(evidence && index===0)
        await page.screenshot({path:'e2e-evidence/wmath022-q16-'+width+'-wrong-hint.png'})
      await panel.getByRole('button',{name:q.answer,exact:true}).click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
      if(index<4)await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-'+q16Ids[index+1])).toBeVisible()
      if(index<4)await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-n14-16')).toHaveCount(0)
    }
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-unit-complete')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByText('左端も右端も絶対値が4となり')).toBeVisible()
    const dims=await page.evaluate(()=>[document.documentElement.scrollWidth,document.documentElement.clientWidth])
    expect(dims[0]).toBeLessThanOrEqual(dims[1]+2)
    if(evidence)await page.screenshot({path:'e2e-evidence/wmath022-q16-'+width+'-complete.png'})
    await page.reload()
    for(const id of q16Ids)await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
    for(const id of ['n14-10','n14-14','n14-15'])await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-'+id)).toBeVisible()
  })
}

// Explicit archival compatibility entry; original test assertions remain unchanged.
function editionHistoricalRoute(path: string) {
  if (!test.info().annotations.some(item => item.type === 'historical-edition')) {
    test.info().annotations.push({ type: 'historical-edition', description: '171c archival Page + pinned shared runtime; not current Page coverage' })
  }
  return '/kyotsu-step-web/e2e/fixtures/historical-math.html#' + path
}
e2e/wmath011-n11-proof.spec.ts
import { expect, test } from '@playwright/test'
import editionData from './fixtures/historical-math-data.json' with { type: 'json' }
import { validateTextbookUnits as editionValidate } from '../src/domain/textbookSchema'

const mathTextbookUnits = editionValidate(editionData.units)

/**
 * W-MATH-011/P-001: a REAL browser walks the nine Q01–Q04 decisions,
 * preserving original source question IDs and independent historical keys.
 * Captures genuine before/wrong/resolved screenshots only when approved
 * evidence workflow enables it. Never deploys this review-only unit.
 */
const ids = [
  'n11-01', 'n11-02', 'n11-wm011-q02-compare',
  'n11-wm011-q03-factor', 'n11-wm011-q03-positive',
  'n11-03', 'n11-wm011-q03-zero',
  'n11-wm011-q04-fraction', 'n11-04',
] as const

for (const width of [320, 390]) {
  test('W-MATH-011 N11 original Q01–Q04 proof and selective 9-step revision at ' + width + 'px', async ({ page }) => {
    test.setTimeout(240_000)
    await page.setViewportSize({ width, height: 850 })
    const unit = mathTextbookUnits.find(u => u.unitId.endsWith('n11'))!
    const original = unit.sections[0].items
    expect(original.length).toBe(31)
    expect(original.slice(0, 9).map(x => x.id)).toEqual([...ids])
    await page.goto(editionHistoricalRoute('/learning/textbook/math-numbers-expressions-n11'))
    await page.evaluate(() => localStorage.clear())
    await page.reload()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-reading-flow')).toBeVisible()

    // Original number-line observation must be visible BEFORE any learner
    // answer, but the completed endpoint-range figure must stay locked.
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n11-f01')).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n11-f02')).toHaveCount(0)
    const save = process.env.E2E_WM011_EVIDENCE === '1'

    for (const item of original.slice(0, 9)) {
      const trigger = page.getByTestId('textbook-item-' + item.id)
      await expect(trigger, item.id).toBeVisible()
      await trigger.click()
      const panel = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + item.id)
      await expect(panel).toBeVisible()
      let correct = panel.getByRole('button', { name: item.answer, exact: true })
      await expect(correct).toBeVisible()
      if (save) {
        await trigger.scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()
        await page.screenshot({ path: 'e2e-evidence/wmath011-' + item.id + '-' + width + '-before.png' })
      }
      for (const option of await panel.locator('.reading-choice-option').all()) {
        const rows = option.locator('.reading-choice-formula-line')
        for (const line of await rows.all()) {
          const m = await line.evaluate(element => [element.scrollWidth, element.clientWidth])
          expect(m[0], item.id + ' mobile choice math overflow').toBeLessThanOrEqual(m[1] + 1)
        }
      }
      const correctId = await correct.getAttribute('data-testid')
      const other = await panel.getByRole('button').all()
      let wrong: (typeof other)[number] | undefined
      for (const button of other) {
        if ((await button.getAttribute('data-testid')) !== correctId) { wrong = button; break }
      }
      expect(wrong, item.id + ' needs visible wrong alternative').toBeDefined()
      await wrong!.click()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + item.id)).toHaveCount(0)
      await trigger.click()
      const retry = page.getByTestId('inline-choice-panel-' + item.id)
      await expect(retry).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-hint-' + item.id)).toBeVisible()
      if (save) await page.screenshot({ path: 'e2e-evidence/wmath011-' + item.id + '-' + width + '-wrong.png' })
      correct = retry.getByRole('button', { name: item.answer, exact: true })
      await correct.click()
      const resolved = page.getByTestId('resolved-' + item.id)
      await expect(resolved).toBeVisible()
      await expect(page.locator('.katex-error')).toHaveCount(0)
      const lines = resolved.locator('.reading-formula-n12-answer-lines > span')
      if (['n11-wm011-q02-compare', 'n11-wm011-q03-positive', 'n11-03',
           'n11-wm011-q03-zero', 'n11-wm011-q04-fraction'].includes(item.id)) {
        await expect(lines).toHaveCount(2)
        for (const line of await lines.all()) {
          const m = await line.evaluate(element => [element.scrollWidth, element.clientWidth])
          expect(m[0], item.id + ' clipped answer math').toBeLessThanOrEqual(m[1] + 1)
        }
      }
      const w = await page.evaluate(() => [document.documentElement.scrollWidth, document.documentElement.clientWidth])
      expect(w[0], item.id + ' document overflow').toBeLessThanOrEqual(w[1] + 2)
      if (save) await page.screenshot({ path: 'e2e-evidence/wmath011-' + item.id + '-' + width + '-resolved.png' })
    }
    await page.reload()
    for (const id of ids) await expect(page.getByTestId('resolved-' + id)).toBeVisible()
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-item-n11-wm017-q05-operation')).toBeVisible()
    // The original complete-solution figure cannot be used to reveal Q05–Q10.
    await expect(page.getByTestId('textbook-figure-n11-f02')).toHaveCount(0)
  })
}

// Explicit archival compatibility entry; original test assertions remain unchanged.
function editionHistoricalRoute(path: string) {
