.top-header { position: sticky; z-index: 20; top: 0; display: flex; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; padding: .55rem 1rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: rgba(248,247,242,.96); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
.header-leading { display: inline-flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; }
.brand { display: inline-flex; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; text-decoration: none; }
.brand-mark { display: grid; width: 38px; height: 38px; place-items: center; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-primary); color: white; font: 700 .75rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.brand strong, .brand small { display: block; line-height: 1.2; }
.brand small { margin-top: .15rem; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .67rem; letter-spacing: .08em; }
.header-actions { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .4rem; color: var(--color-primary); }
.header-back-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; padding: .25rem .55rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-primary); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }
.header-back-link:hover { background: var(--color-section); }
.language-switcher { display: inline-flex; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-paper); }
.language-switcher button { min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; padding: .25rem .48rem; border: 0; border-right: 1px solid var(--color-primary); background: transparent; color: var(--color-primary); font: 700 .72rem/1 sans-serif; cursor: pointer; }
.language-switcher button:last-child { border-right: 0; }
.language-switcher button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; }
.app-content { min-height: calc(100dvh - 64px); padding: 1.25rem 1rem calc(96px + var(--safe-bottom)); }
.app-frame--focus .app-content { padding-bottom: 2rem; }
.bottom-navigation { position: fixed; z-index: 30; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; display: grid; width: min(100%, var(--content-max)); min-height: calc(72px + var(--safe-bottom)); margin: 0 auto; padding-bottom: var(--safe-bottom); grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); border-top: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.nav-item { display: flex; min-width: 0; min-height: 72px; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .2rem; border-inline-start: 1px solid var(--color-line); color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .69rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; }
.nav-item:first-child { border-inline-start: 0; }
.nav-item--active { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; }
.page-stack { display: grid; gap: 1.5rem; }
.page-hero { padding: .5rem 0 1rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); }
.page-hero h1 { margin: .25rem 0 .5rem; font-size: clamp(2rem, 9vw, 3.75rem); line-height: 1.16; letter-spacing: -.03em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.page-hero p:last-child { max-width: 52ch; margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted); }
.numbered-section { border-top: 2px solid var(--color-border); }
.section-heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 52px 1fr; background: var(--color-section); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); }
.section-heading > span { display: grid; place-items: center; border-right: 2px solid var(--color-border); font: 700 1.05rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.section-heading > div { min-width: 0; padding: .7rem .85rem; }
.section-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
.section-heading p { margin: .18rem 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .78rem; }
.section-body { display: grid; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; }
.raised-button, .raised-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: .65rem 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); background: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-key); color: var(--color-text); font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; }
.raised-button:not(:disabled):active, .raised-link:active { transform: translateY(3px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-border); }
.raised-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .5; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-border); }
.status-badge { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; padding: .3rem .5rem; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: var(--color-primary); font-size: .76rem; font-weight: 700; }
.status-badge--success { color: var(--color-success); }
.status-badge--error { color: var(--color-error); }
.status-badge--muted { color: var(--color-muted); }
.state-panel { padding: 1.35rem 1rem; border: 2px dashed var(--color-line); background: var(--color-paper); text-align: center; }
.state-panel h2 { margin: .45rem 0 .35rem; font-size: 1.1rem; }
.state-panel p { max-width: 44ch; margin: 0 auto 1rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.state-panel__mark { font: 700 2rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.state-panel--error { border-color: var(--color-error); color: var(--color-error); }
.state-panel--error p { color: var(--color-text); }
.inline-link { min-height: 48px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; width: fit-content; font-weight: 700; }
.progress-block { display: grid; gap: .35rem; }
.progress-label { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 700; }
.progress-track { height: 10px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-section); }
.progress-track span { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--color-primary); }
.sheet-backdrop, .dialog-backdrop { position: fixed; z-index: 60; inset: 0; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: center; background: rgba(26,42,60,.48); }
.bottom-sheet { width: min(100%, var(--content-max)); max-height: min(78dvh, 720px); overflow: auto; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); border-bottom: 0; background: var(--color-bg); box-shadow: 0 -8px 30px rgba(26,42,60,.22); }
.bottom-sheet > header { position: sticky; top: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: .85rem 1rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-section); }
.bottom-sheet h2, .confirm-dialog h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; }
.bottom-sheet__body { padding: 1rem; }
.icon-button, .text-button { min-width: 48px; min-height: 48px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; }
.dialog-backdrop { align-items: center; padding: 1rem; }
.confirm-dialog { width: min(100%, 440px); padding: 1.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-bg); box-shadow: 8px 8px 0 rgba(26,42,60,.35); }
.confirm-dialog p { color: var(--color-muted); }
.button-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; gap: .75rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.content-renderer { display: grid; gap: 1rem; min-width: 0; }
.content-renderer > p { margin: 0; white-space: pre-line; }
.dialogue-block { display: grid; gap: .35rem; padding: .75rem .85rem; border-left: 4px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.dialogue-block strong { color: var(--color-primary); font-size: .78rem; }
.dialogue-block p { margin: 0; white-space: pre-line; }
.common-test-stepper { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.common-test-step { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: .25rem; padding: .6rem .4rem; place-items: center; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border); color: var(--color-muted); text-align: center; }
.common-test-step:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.common-test-step > span { display: grid; width: 26px; height: 26px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; font: 700 .72rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.common-test-step small { font-size: .68rem; font-weight: 700; }
.common-test-step--active { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; }
.common-test-screen { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.screen-kicker { width: fit-content; padding: .3rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); font: 700 .72rem/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.original-choice-preview, .final-choice-list { display: grid; gap: .65rem; }
.original-choice-preview h2, .final-choice-list h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
.original-choice, .final-choice { display: grid; min-width: 0; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .7rem .8rem; grid-template-columns: 34px minmax(0, 1fr); border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); text-align: left; }
.original-choice > span, .final-choice > span { display: grid; width: 30px; height: 30px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); font: 700 .8rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.final-choice { color: var(--color-text); cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--color-border); }
.final-choice:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-border); }
.final-choice--wrong { border-color: var(--color-error); background: #fff8f6; color: var(--color-error); }
.final-retry { display: grid; gap: .65rem; padding: .8rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-error); background: #fff8f6; }
.final-retry p { margin: 0; }
.question-paper--compact { max-height: 44dvh; overflow: auto; }
.guide-reference-panel { position: sticky; z-index: 11; top: 74px; display: grid; gap: .45rem; padding: .65rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: rgba(248,247,242,.97); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(26,42,60,.12); backdrop-filter: blur(8px); }
.guide-reference-panel__label { width: fit-content; padding: .18rem .38rem; background: var(--color-primary); color: white; font: 700 .68rem/1.35 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.guide-reference-panel .question-figure { margin: 0; }
.guide-reference-panel .question-figure img { display: block; width: 100%; max-height: 30dvh; object-fit: contain; }
.guide-reference-panel .question-figure figcaption { margin-top: .3rem; font-size: .7rem; text-align: center; }
.filled-blank--recovered { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.filled-blank--recovered .blank-state-label { color: var(--color-primary); }
.formula-scroll, .table-scroll { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; overscroll-behavior-inline: contain; }
.formula-scroll { padding: .65rem .2rem; border-block: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-paper); }
.formula-scroll .katex-display { width: max-content; min-width: 100%; margin: 0; text-align: center; }
.formula-inline { display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; }
.question-figure, .question-table-wrap { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; margin: 0; }
.question-figure img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.question-figure figcaption, .question-table-wrap figcaption { margin-top: .4rem; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .78rem; }
.question-table-wrap figcaption { margin: 0 0 .4rem; font-weight: 700; }
.question-table-wrap table { width: 100%; min-width: 460px; border-collapse: collapse; background: var(--color-paper); font-size: .86rem; }
.question-table-wrap th, .question-table-wrap td { padding: .6rem .7rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); text-align: left; }
.question-table-wrap th { background: var(--color-section); }
.content-error { padding: .75rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-error); color: var(--color-error); }
.field-label { font-weight: 700; font-size: .82rem; }
.select-control, .text-control, .textarea-control { width: 100%; min-height: 48px; padding: .65rem .75rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-text); }
.tag-row { display: flex; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.structure-list { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.5rem; }
.structure-list li { padding: .35rem 0; border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--color-line); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: .82rem; }
.resume-strip, .mode-card { display: grid; min-height: 72px; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; padding: .8rem 1rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-key); text-decoration: none; }
.resume-strip { background: var(--color-section); }
.resume-strip span, .mode-card span { min-width: 0; }
.resume-strip strong, .resume-strip small, .mode-card strong, .mode-card small { display: block; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.resume-strip small, .mode-card small { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; }
.segmented-control { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); border: 2px solid var(--color-border); }
.segmented-control button { min-height: 52px; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); cursor: pointer; }
.segmented-control button:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.segmented-control button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; font-weight: 700; }
.choice-grid { display: grid; gap: .65rem; }
.choice-grid button { min-height: 64px; padding: .7rem .85rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.choice-grid button[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; box-shadow: var(--shadow-key); }
.choice-grid strong, .choice-grid small { display: block; }
.choice-grid small { margin-top: .2rem; opacity: .82; }
.primary-button { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; }
.session-header { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding-bottom: .75rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); }
.session-header h1 { margin: .2rem 0 0; font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 6vw, 2rem); line-height: 1.3; }
.question-paper { padding: 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 4px var(--color-bg); }
.solution-heading { margin: 0 0 1rem; padding-bottom: .45rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); font-size: 1.2rem; }
.learning-flow { display: grid; gap: .8rem; }
.learning-flow > .content-renderer { padding: .25rem 0; }
.empty-blank { display: grid; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; gap: .2rem .65rem; padding: .65rem .8rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; border: 2px dashed var(--color-muted); background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.empty-blank small { grid-column: 2; color: var(--color-muted); }
.empty-blank--active { border-style: solid; border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: var(--shadow-key); color: var(--color-primary); }
.filled-blank { position: relative; display: grid; gap: .55rem; padding: .8rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.filled-blank--guided { border-style: dashed; border-color: var(--color-line); }
.filled-blank--correct { border-color: var(--color-success); }
.filled-blank--wrong { border-color: var(--color-error); background: #fff8f6; }
.blank-state-label { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: .25rem; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; }
.filled-blank--correct .blank-state-label { color: var(--color-success); }
.filled-blank--wrong .blank-state-label { color: var(--color-error); }
.blank-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.analysis-link, .revisit-link { min-height: 48px; border: 0; background: transparent; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; }
.analysis-link { color: var(--color-error); }
.revisit-link { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .75rem; }
.option-list, .explanation-stack { display: grid; gap: .8rem; }
.option-button { width: 100%; min-height: 56px; padding: .7rem .8rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--color-border); color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.option-button[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; }
.option-button .content-renderer { gap: .25rem; }
.explanation-stack section { padding-bottom: 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.explanation-stack h3 { margin: 0 0 .45rem; font-size: .92rem; }
.score-board { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.score-board span { display: grid; min-width: 0; padding: .8rem .4rem; place-items: center; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-border); text-align: center; }
.score-board span:first-child { border-left: 0; }
.score-board strong { font: 700 clamp(1.35rem, 7vw, 2.25rem)/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.score-board small { margin-top: .4rem; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .65rem; }
.result-list { display: grid; gap: .65rem; }
.result-row { display: grid; align-items: start; gap: .65rem; padding: .8rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; border: 2px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-paper); }
.result-row--correct { border-color: var(--color-success); }
.result-row--wrong { border-color: var(--color-error); }
.result-row h3, .result-row p { margin: 0; }
.result-row h3 { font-size: .88rem; }
.result-row p { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .78rem; }
.result-row--wrong > svg { color: var(--color-error); }
.result-row--correct > svg { color: var(--color-success); }
.result-actions { display: grid; gap: .8rem; }
.selected-question-list { display: grid; gap: .6rem; }
.selected-question-list > div { display: flex; min-height: 52px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .6rem; padding: .6rem .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.simulation-header { display: flex; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between; gap: .8rem; padding-bottom: .75rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); }
.simulation-header h1 { margin: .2rem 0 0; font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 5vw, 1.7rem); line-height: 1.35; }
.timer-box { display: grid; min-width: 92px; min-height: 54px; padding: .35rem .55rem; place-items: center; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: .3rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; }
.timer-box--urgent { border-color: var(--color-error); color: var(--color-error); }
.question-navigator { display: flex; gap: .5rem; overflow-x: auto; padding: 0 0 .3rem; }
.question-navigator button { min-width: 58px; min-height: 52px; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); cursor: pointer; }
.question-navigator button[aria-current="step"] { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; }
.question-navigator small { display: block; font-size: .62rem; }
.simulation-items { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.simulation-item { display: grid; gap: .8rem; padding: .9rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.simulation-item > header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; padding-bottom: .5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.simulation-item h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; }
.review-button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; gap: .3rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: transparent; color: var(--color-muted); cursor: pointer; }
.review-button--active { background: var(--color-section); color: var(--color-primary); font-weight: 700; }
.simulation-options { display: grid; gap: .6rem; }
.simulation-options > button { display: grid; min-height: 56px; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; padding: .65rem .75rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-bg); color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.simulation-options > button[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--color-primary); color: white; }
.selection-mark { font: 700 1.05rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.number-answer { display: grid; gap: .35rem; font-weight: 700; }
.session-controls { display: grid; gap: .8rem; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
.session-controls .raised-button { min-width: 0; padding-inline: .45rem; }
.submit-button { position: sticky; z-index: 12; bottom: max(1rem, var(--safe-bottom)); width: 100%; margin-top: .5rem; background: var(--color-text); color: white; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 var(--color-border), 0 -8px 20px var(--color-bg); }
.recommendation-list { display: grid; gap: .65rem; }
.recommendation-list article { display: grid; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; padding: .75rem; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.recommendation-list strong, .recommendation-list small { display: block; }
.recommendation-list small { margin-top: .2rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.analytics-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.analytics-grid article { display: grid; min-width: 0; min-height: 122px; padding: .8rem .5rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); text-align: center; }
.analytics-grid svg { color: var(--color-primary); }
.analytics-grid strong { font: 700 clamp(1.45rem, 7vw, 2.2rem)/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.analytics-grid small { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .68rem; }
.metric-list { display: grid; gap: .7rem; }
.metric-list > a { display: grid; align-items: center; gap: .7rem; padding: .75rem; grid-template-columns: minmax(96px, .8fr) minmax(150px, 1.2fr) auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); text-decoration: none; }
.metric-list strong, .metric-list small { display: block; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.metric-list small { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .7rem; }
.mistake-list, .history-list { display: grid; gap: .75rem; }
.mistake-list article { display: grid; gap: .75rem; padding: .8rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.mistake-list article > header { display: grid; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; }
.mistake-list header strong, .mistake-list header small { display: block; }
.mistake-list header small { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; }
.plain-tag { padding: .2rem .4rem; background: var(--color-section); border: 1px solid var(--color-line); font: 700 .68rem/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.history-list > a { display: grid; align-items: start; gap: .75rem; padding: .85rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); text-decoration: none; }
.history-list strong, .history-list small { display: block; }
.history-list small, .history-list p, .history-list time { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; }
.history-list p { margin: .35rem 0 0; }
.history-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem; margin-bottom: .35rem; }
.ranking-callout { display: grid; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding: .85rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.ranking-callout p { margin: .2rem 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .78rem; }
.ranking-list { display: grid; gap: .55rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.ranking-list li { display: grid; min-height: 64px; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .6rem .75rem; grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.ranking-list li > div > strong, .ranking-list li > div > small { display: block; }
.ranking-list li > div > small { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .7rem; }
.ranking-list__me { border-width: 2px !important; border-color: var(--color-primary) !important; background: var(--color-section) !important; }
.rank-number { display: grid; place-items: center; font: 700 1.05rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.toggle-row { display: grid; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: .75rem; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); cursor: pointer; }
.toggle-row > span { display: grid; align-items: center; gap: .25rem .55rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; }
.toggle-row small { grid-column: 2; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; }
.toggle-row input { width: 28px; height: 28px; accent-color: var(--color-primary); }
.data-summary { display: grid; align-items: start; gap: .75rem; padding: .75rem; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-paper); }
.data-summary p { margin: 0; }
.danger-button { color: var(--color-error); border-color: var(--color-error); }
.app-frame--reduce-motion *, .app-frame--reduce-motion *::before, .app-frame--reduce-motion *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; animation-duration: .01ms !important; }
.button-row--start { justify-content: flex-start; }
.file-button { position: relative; overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; }
.file-button input { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; opacity: 0; }
.json-editor { min-height: 240px; resize: vertical; font: 400 .76rem/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; tab-size: 2; }
.notice-box, .issue-box { padding: .75rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-success); background: var(--color-paper); }
.issue-box { border-color: var(--color-error); color: var(--color-error); }
.issue-box ol { margin: .5rem 0 0; padding-left: 1.4rem; }
.issue-box li { padding: .25rem 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; font: 400 .72rem/1.5 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.fatal-error { width: min(calc(100% - 2rem), 680px); margin: 2rem auto; padding: 1.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-error); background: var(--color-bg); box-shadow: var(--shadow-key); }
@media (min-width: 760px) { .app-content { padding-inline: 2rem; } .page-hero { padding-top: 1.5rem; } }
@media (max-width: 420px) { .metric-list > a { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } .metric-list .progress-block { grid-column: 1 / -1; grid-row: 2; } }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { scroll-behavior: auto !important; transition-duration: .01ms !important; animation-duration: .01ms !important; } }


/* Textbook learning mode */
.learning-mode-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .75rem; }
.learning-mode-grid > button { display: grid; min-height: 132px; gap: .45rem; align-content: start; padding: .9rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--color-border); }
.learning-mode-grid > button[aria-checked="true"] { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 var(--color-primary); }
.learning-mode-grid svg { color: var(--color-primary); }
.learning-mode-grid strong { font-size: .98rem; }
.learning-mode-grid small { color: var(--color-muted); line-height: 1.55; }
.field-help { margin: .65rem 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .78rem; }
.setup-progress-note { display: grid; gap: .2rem; margin-top: .7rem; padding: .7rem .8rem; border-left: 4px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.setup-progress-note span { font-weight: 700; }
.setup-progress-note small { color: var(--color-muted); }

.textbook-part-list { display: grid; gap: 1.4rem; }
.textbook-part-group { display: grid; gap: .8rem; }
.textbook-part-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .65rem .75rem; border-left: 5px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.textbook-part-heading span { color: var(--color-primary); font: 700 .76rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-part-heading strong { font-size: 1.05rem; }
.textbook-chapter-list { display: grid; gap: 1rem; }
.textbook-chapter-card { display: grid; gap: .8rem; padding: .9rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.textbook-chapter-card--pending { opacity: .68; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-paper) 82%, var(--color-section)); }
.textbook-chapter-card > header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .75rem; padding-bottom: .65rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.textbook-chapter-card > header > span { display: grid; min-width: 58px; min-height: 36px; place-items: center; padding: .2rem .45rem; background: var(--color-primary); color: white; font: 700 .72rem/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-chapter-card > header > div { display: grid; gap: .1rem; }
.textbook-chapter-card > header strong { font-size: 1rem; }
.textbook-chapter-card > header small { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; }
.textbook-unit-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 230px), 1fr)); gap: .6rem; }
.textbook-unit-link { display: grid; min-width: 0; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; min-height: 70px; padding: .75rem .8rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: white; color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-border); }
.textbook-unit-link:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-primary); }
.textbook-unit-link > div { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: .12rem; }
.textbook-unit-link strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: 1rem; }
.textbook-unit-link small { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .7rem; }
.textbook-chunk-link { min-height: 88px; }
.textbook-chunk-flow { line-height: 1.5; }
.textbook-current-topic { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .45rem; margin: .35rem 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .78rem; }
.textbook-current-topic span { padding: .12rem .35rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: var(--color-section); font: 700 .65rem/1.2 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-current-topic strong { color: var(--color-text); font-size: .84rem; }
.textbook-unit-percent { color: var(--color-primary); font: 700 .72rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-chapter-pending { margin: 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .78rem; }

.textbook-page { padding-bottom: 2rem; }
.textbook-objectives { display: grid; gap: .6rem; padding: 1rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.textbook-objectives strong { color: var(--color-primary); }
.textbook-objectives ol { display: grid; gap: .35rem; margin: 0; padding-left: 1.4rem; }
.textbook-objectives li { line-height: 1.5; }
.textbook-section-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .45rem; }
.textbook-section-nav button { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: .28rem; align-content: start; padding: .65rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; }
.textbook-section-nav button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }
.textbook-section-nav button[aria-pressed="true"] { border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.textbook-section-nav button > span { display: grid; width: 26px; height: 26px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid currentColor; color: var(--color-primary); font: 700 .7rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-section-nav strong { min-width: 0; font-size: .74rem; line-height: 1.35; }
.textbook-section-nav small { color: var(--color-muted); font: 600 .68rem/1.3 ui-monospace, monospace; }

.textbook-section-stack { display: grid; gap: 1.6rem; }
.textbook-section { display: grid; gap: 1rem; scroll-margin-top: 1rem; }
.textbook-section + .textbook-section { padding-top: 1rem; border-top: 3px solid var(--color-border); }
.textbook-section-heading { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: .8rem; padding-bottom: .7rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--color-border); }
.textbook-section-heading > div { display: flex; min-width: 0; gap: .7rem; }
.textbook-section-heading > div > span { display: grid; flex: 0 0 38px; width: 38px; height: 38px; place-items: center; background: var(--color-primary); color: white; font: 700 .72rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-section-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.2rem; }
.textbook-section-heading p { margin: .25rem 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); line-height: 1.6; }
.textbook-section-heading > strong { white-space: nowrap; font: 700 .78rem/1.4 ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--color-primary); }

.textbook-figures { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 320px), 1fr)); gap: .8rem; }
.textbook-figures figure { display: grid; gap: .45rem; margin: 0; padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: white; }
.textbook-figures img { display: block; width: 100%; max-height: 360px; object-fit: contain; }
.textbook-figures figcaption { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; text-align: center; }

.textbook-check-list { display: grid; gap: .65rem; }
.textbook-check-item { display: grid; gap: .6rem; padding: .8rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.textbook-check-item--correct { border-color: var(--color-success); }
.textbook-check-item--wrong { border-color: var(--color-error); background: #fff8f6; }
.textbook-check-item > header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; }
.textbook-check-item > header > span { padding: .18rem .4rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); font: 700 .72rem/1.35 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-check-item > header > small { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .2rem; margin-left: auto; font-weight: 700; }
.textbook-check-item--correct > header > small { color: var(--color-success); }
.textbook-check-item--wrong > header > small { color: var(--color-error); }
.textbook-check-item > p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.65; }
.textbook-choice-list { display: grid; gap: .5rem; }
.textbook-choice { display: grid; min-width: 0; grid-template-columns: 32px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; min-height: 50px; padding: .55rem .7rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: white; color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-border); }
.textbook-choice:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.textbook-choice:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-border); }
.textbook-choice:disabled { cursor: default; opacity: .62; }
.textbook-choice > span { display: grid; width: 28px; height: 28px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); font: 700 .72rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-choice > strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: .9rem; }
.textbook-choice > small { color: var(--color-muted); font-weight: 700; }
.textbook-choice--wrong { border-color: var(--color-error); background: #fff8f6; color: var(--color-error); }
.textbook-choice--correct { border-color: var(--color-success); background: #f6fff8; color: var(--color-success); opacity: 1 !important; }
.textbook-choice--correct > span { border-color: var(--color-success); }
.textbook-answer-row { display: flex; align-items: stretch; gap: .5rem; }
.textbook-answer-row input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; min-height: 46px; padding: .55rem .7rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: white; color: var(--color-text); font: inherit; }
.textbook-answer-row input:focus { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 22%, transparent); border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.textbook-answer-row input:disabled { background: var(--color-section); color: var(--color-text); opacity: 1; }
.textbook-unit-label { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 .25rem; color: var(--color-muted); font-weight: 700; }
.textbook-feedback { font-size: .74rem; }
.textbook-feedback--wrong { color: var(--color-error); }
.textbook-feedback--correct { color: var(--color-success); }

.textbook-next-panel, .textbook-complete-panel { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .8rem; padding: .9rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.textbook-next-panel > svg, .textbook-complete-panel > svg { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--color-primary); }
.textbook-next-panel > div, .textbook-complete-panel > div { display: grid; flex: 1; gap: .2rem; }
.textbook-next-panel small { color: var(--color-muted); }
.textbook-complete-panel h2, .textbook-complete-panel p { margin: 0; }
.textbook-complete-panel p { margin-top: .25rem; color: var(--color-muted); }
.textbook-reset { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; width: fit-content; }

/* Guided textbook reading flow */
.textbook-reading-flow { display: grid; gap: 1rem; padding: clamp(.9rem, 2vw, 1.35rem); border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.reading-subheading { margin: 1rem 0 .1rem; padding: .55rem .7rem; border-left: 5px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); font-size: 1.05rem; }
.reading-subheading:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.reading-note { padding: .7rem .8rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.65; }
.reading-paragraph { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 2.05; }
.reading-paragraph > span { display: inline; }
.reading-paragraph .katex { font-size: 1.03em; }
.reading-formula-line { overflow-x: auto; padding: .7rem .85rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line); background: #fff; font-size: 1.08rem; line-height: 2; text-align: center; white-space: nowrap; }
.reading-formula-line > span { display: inline; }
.reading-figure { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: .5rem; margin: .4rem 0; padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: white; }
.reading-figure img { display: block; width: auto; max-width: min(100%, 760px); height: auto; max-height: 560px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: auto; }
.reading-figure figcaption { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .74rem; text-align: center; }
.textbook-figure-stage { position: relative; width: fit-content; max-width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; }
.textbook-figure-stage > img { display: block; width: auto; max-width: 100%; height: auto; max-height: 560px; object-fit: contain; image-rendering: auto; }
/* Existing math-set SVGs have viewBox but no intrinsic width/height attributes.
   Explicit stage width avoids a fit-content/auto sizing cycle collapsing the image
   while leaving physics raster figure sizing untouched. */
.textbook-figure-stage--math-set-svg { width: min(100%, 720px); }
.textbook-figure-stage--math-set-svg > img { width: 100%; height: auto; }
.textbook-figure-overlay { position: absolute; display: grid; min-width: 24px; min-height: 24px; place-items: center; padding: 0; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); cursor: pointer; }
.textbook-figure-overlay > span { padding: .1rem .22rem; background: var(--color-paper); font: 700 .62rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.textbook-figure-overlay--mask { background: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(255,255,255,.72); }
.textbook-figure-overlay--hotspot { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 12%, transparent); border-style: dashed; }
.textbook-figure-overlay:hover, .textbook-figure-overlay:focus-visible { background: var(--color-section); }

.reading-inline-blank, .reading-inline-answer { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; gap: .3rem; margin: 0 .16rem; padding: .15rem .45rem; vertical-align: baseline; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: white; color: var(--color-primary); line-height: 1.35; }
button.reading-inline-blank { font: inherit; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: none; }
button.reading-inline-blank:hover { background: var(--color-section); }
.reading-inline-blank > strong { font-size: .86rem; }
.reading-inline-blank--wrong { border-color: var(--color-error); color: var(--color-error); background: #fff8f6; }
.reading-inline-answer { display: inline; min-height: 0; margin: 0 .08rem; padding: 0; border: 0; background: transparent; color: inherit; line-height: inherit; }
.reading-inline-answer strong { font-size: inherit; font-weight: inherit; }

.reading-choice-panel { display: grid; gap: .65rem; margin: .1rem 0 .25rem; padding: .8rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.reading-choice-panel__head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .5rem; }
.reading-choice-panel__head > span { padding: .15rem .38rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); font: 700 .68rem/1.35 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.reading-choice-panel__head > strong { font-size: .85rem; }
.reading-choice-panel__head > small { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .2rem; margin-left: auto; color: var(--color-error); font-weight: 700; }
.reading-choice-options { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: .5rem; }
.reading-choice-option { display: grid; min-width: 0; grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .55rem; min-height: 50px; padding: .55rem .65rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: white; color: var(--color-text); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-border); }
.reading-choice-option:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.reading-choice-option:active { transform: translateY(1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-border); }
.reading-choice-option > span { display: grid; width: 27px; height: 27px; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); font: 700 .7rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
.reading-choice-option > strong { overflow-wrap: anywhere; font-size: .88rem; }
.reading-choice-option > small { color: var(--color-muted); font-weight: 700; }
/* Math textbook P-003: keep each long mathematical alternative intact. */
.reading-choice-options--math-wide { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
.reading-choice-options--math-wide .reading-choice-option { grid-template-columns: 30px minmax(0, 1fr); }
.reading-choice-formula-lines { display: grid; min-width: 0; width: 100%; gap: .3rem; font-weight: 500; }
.reading-choice-formula-line { display: block; min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; white-space: nowrap; overflow-wrap: normal; line-height: 1.7; }
.reading-choice-formula-line .katex { font-size: .98em; }
.reading-choice-option--wrong { border-color: var(--color-error); background: #fff8f6; color: var(--color-error); }
.reading-choice-panel > p { margin: 0; color: var(--color-error); font-size: .75rem; }

.reading-subsection { display: grid; gap: .9rem; }
.reading-subsection + .reading-subsection { margin-top: .3rem; padding-top: .35rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-line); }
.reading-subsection-complete { display: inline-flex; width: fit-content; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; padding: .35rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-success); background: #f6fff8; color: var(--color-success); font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 700; }

.reading-sheet-choice-list { display: grid; gap: .6rem; }
.reading-sheet-prompt { margin: 0 0 .15rem; line-height: 1.6; }
.reading-sheet-choice-list .reading-choice-option { width: 100%; }
.reading-sheet-error { margin: 0; color: var(--color-error); font-size: .78rem; }

.reading-block-with-choice { display: grid; gap: .55rem; }
.reading-inline-choice-panel { display: grid; gap: .6rem; margin: .1rem 0 .25rem; padding: .75rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.reading-inline-choice-panel__head { display: grid; gap: .2rem; }
.reading-inline-choice-panel__head span { font-size: .82rem; line-height: 1.55; }


/* Physics taxonomy board */
.physics-taxonomy-board { display: grid; gap: 1.35rem; }
.physics-domain-group { display: grid; gap: .75rem; }
.physics-domain-heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(24px, 1fr) auto minmax(24px, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: .8rem; }
.physics-domain-heading > span { height: 2px; background: var(--color-border); }
.physics-domain-heading h3 { margin: 0; color: var(--color-primary); font-size: 1rem; letter-spacing: .18em; white-space: nowrap; }
.physics-topic-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 170px), 1fr)); gap: .7rem; }
.physics-topic-card { position: relative; display: grid; min-height: 88px; place-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.9rem .85rem .85rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); box-shadow: var(--shadow-key); color: var(--color-text); text-align: center; text-decoration: none; }
.physics-topic-card strong { font-size: 1.05rem; letter-spacing: .04em; }
.physics-topic-card small { position: absolute; top: .4rem; right: .5rem; color: var(--color-muted); font: 700 .72rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; }
a.physics-topic-card:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
a.physics-topic-card:active { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--color-border); }
.physics-topic-card--empty { opacity: .42; box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-border); }
.topic-filter-note { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto minmax(0, 1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: .65rem; padding: .65rem .75rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-section); }
.topic-filter-note span { color: var(--color-muted); font-size: .72rem; font-weight: 700; }
.topic-filter-note strong { color: var(--color-primary); }
.topic-filter-note small { font: 700 .72rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace; color: var(--color-primary); }


button.physics-topic-card {
  width: 100%;
  font: inherit;
  cursor: pointer;
}

button.physics-topic-card:disabled {
  cursor: default;
}

button.physics-topic-card:not(:disabled):hover {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

.physics-topic-card--selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 24%, transparent);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

/* Math practice reuses the proven physics taxonomy shell, but titles carry a short learning flow. */
.math-topic-card {
  align-content: center;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: .28rem;
  min-height: 104px;
  padding: .9rem 2.2rem .9rem .9rem;
  text-align: left;
}

.math-topic-card strong {
  font-size: 1.02rem;
}

.math-topic-flow {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: .72rem;
  line-height: 1.5;
}

.math-topic-filter-copy {
  display: grid;
  min-width: 0;
  gap: .12rem;
}

.math-topic-filter-copy > small {
  position: static;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.math-exercise-type-grid button {
  min-height: 112px;
}

.math-practice-chapter-list {
  gap: 1rem;
}

button.math-theme-link {
  width: 100%;
  font: inherit;
}

.math-theme-link {
  text-align: left;
}

.math-theme-link--empty {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: .42;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-border);
}

.math-theme-link--selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 24%, transparent);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

.math-common-test-grid {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(min(100%, 260px), 1fr));
}

.math-problem-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(74px, 1fr));
  gap: .65rem;
}

.math-problem-button {
  min-height: 58px;
  padding: .75rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  background: var(--color-paper);
  color: var(--color-text);
  font: 700 1rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-key);
}

.math-problem-button:hover,
.math-problem-button:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

.math-problem-button--selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  outline: 2px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 24%, transparent);
  background: var(--color-section);
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.math-common-test-question-list {
  display: grid;
  gap: .65rem;
}

.math-common-test-question {
  min-height: 64px;
  padding: .8rem .9rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  background: var(--color-paper);
  color: var(--color-text);
  font: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-key);
}

.math-common-test-question:hover,
.math-common-test-question:focus-visible,
.math-common-test-question--selected {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

.math-topic-question-nav {
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
  margin: 0 0 1rem;
  padding: 0 0 .85rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line);
}

.math-topic-question-nav__status {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: space-between;
  gap: .75rem;
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: .78rem;
}

.math-topic-question-nav__status strong {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font: 700 .78rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace;
}

.math-topic-question-nav__cards {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: .45rem;
}

.math-topic-question-card {
  display: grid;
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 0;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  background: var(--color-paper);
  color: var(--color-text);
  font: 700 .82rem/1 ui-monospace, monospace;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-border);
}

.math-topic-question-card:hover,
.math-topic-question-card:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

.math-topic-question-card--current {
  border-color: var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-primary);
  color: white;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 0 var(--color-primary);
}

/* Math practice 87 design pilot: reuse the successful Physics textbook reading language. */
.math-practice-target-anchor {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: .45rem .75rem;
  margin: 0 0 .65rem;
  padding: .7rem .85rem;
  border-left: 4px solid var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

.math-practice-target-anchor > span {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}

.math-practice-target-anchor > strong {
  color: var(--color-text);
  font-size: .95rem;
  line-height: 1.45;
}

.math-practice-target-anchor__math .katex {
  font-size: 1.05em;
}

.math-practice-inline-math {
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.math-practice-content-renderer > p {
  margin: 0;
}

.math-practice-dependency-links {
  display: grid;
  gap: .42rem;
  margin: 0 0 .7rem;
}

.math-practice-dependency-links__label {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: .7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}

.math-practice-dependency-item {
  display: grid;
  gap: .35rem;
}

.math-practice-dependency-summary {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: .35rem .65rem;
  padding: .45rem .62rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  background: #fcfbf7;
}

.math-practice-dependency-link {
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font: 700 .78rem/1.4 inherit;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-underline-offset: 3px;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.math-practice-dependency-link:hover,
.math-practice-dependency-link:focus-visible {
  color: var(--color-text);
  outline: none;
}

.math-practice-dependency-result {
  display: inline-flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: .3rem .55rem;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: .88rem;
}

.math-practice-dependency-result__item {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: .12rem;
  min-width: 0;
}

.math-practice-dependency-result .content-renderer,
.math-practice-dependency-result .content-renderer > p {
  display: inline;
  margin: 0;
}

.math-practice-dependency-detail {
  display: grid;
  gap: .45rem;
  margin-left: .35rem;
  padding: .55rem .7rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-line);
  background: var(--color-section);
  font-size: .9rem;
}

.math-practice-dependency-detail .math-practice-reading-line {
  font-size: .9rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.math-practice-reading-flow {
  display: grid;
  gap: .9rem;
  padding: clamp(.9rem, 2vw, 1.35rem);
  border: 2px solid var(--color-border);
  background: var(--color-paper);
}

.math-practice-reading-content {
  min-width: 0;
}

.math-practice-reading-content .content-renderer {
  display: grid;
  gap: .45rem;
}

.math-practice-reading-content .content-renderer > p {
  margin: 0;
  line-height: 2.05;
}

.math-practice-reading-content .formula-scroll {
  margin: 0;
}

.math-practice-reading-block {
  display: grid;
  gap: .55rem;
}

.math-practice-reading-line {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: baseline;
  gap: .38rem;
  min-width: 0;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 2.05;
}

.math-practice-inline-answer {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  margin: 0 .08rem;
  padding: 0;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
}

.math-practice-inline-answer .content-renderer,
.math-practice-inline-answer .content-renderer > p {
  display: inline;
  margin: 0;
}

.math-practice-choice-content {
  min-width: 0;
}

.math-practice-choice-content .content-renderer {
  display: block;
}

.math-practice-choice-content .content-renderer > p {
  margin: 0;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  font-size: .88rem;
}

.math-practice-reading-flow .reading-choice-hint .content-renderer > p {
  margin: 0;
}

.math-practice-complete-panel {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .8rem;
  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: .9rem;
  border: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section);
}

.math-practice-complete-panel > div {
  display: grid;
  flex: 1;
  gap: .2rem;
}

.math-practice-complete-panel strong {
  color: var(--color-primary);
}

.math-practice-complete-panel small {
  color: var(--color-muted);
  line-height: 1.5;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .math-practice-complete-panel {
    align-items: stretch;
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .math-practice-complete-panel button {
    width: 100%;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .math-problem-grid {
    grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));
  }

  .math-problem-button {
    min-width: 0;
  }

  .math-topic-question-nav__cards {
    gap: .4rem;
  }

  .math-topic-question-card {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
  }
}


/* Textbook formula holes are rendered inside one complete KaTeX expression. */
.reading-formula-line .katex-display { margin: 0; }
.reading-formula-line .tb-math-choice a,
.reading-formula-line .tb-math-answer {
  text-decoration: none;
}
.reading-formula-line .tb-math-choice a {
  color: var(--color-primary);
  cursor: pointer;
}
.reading-formula-line .tb-math-choice a:hover,
.reading-formula-line .tb-math-choice a:focus-visible {
  color: var(--color-text);
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
  outline-offset: 3px;
}
.reading-formula-line .tb-math-choice-wrong a {
  color: var(--color-error);
}
.reading-formula-line .tb-math-answer {
  color: inherit;
  background: transparent;
}
.reading-formula-line--error {
  border-color: var(--color-error);
  color: var(--color-error);
}
.reading-formula-error {
  font-weight: 700;
}

/* Figure masks should invite interaction without exposing internal item IDs. */
.textbook-figure-overlay > span {
  min-width: 1.25rem;
  text-align: center;
  font-family: inherit;
}

.reading-derivation-chain {
  display: grid;
  gap: .15rem;
  margin: .55rem 0;
  padding: .55rem .7rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-primary);
  background: #fcfbf7;
}

.reading-derivation-step {
  min-width: 0;
}

.reading-derivation-chain .reading-block-with-choice {
  gap: .3rem;
}

.reading-derivation-chain .reading-paragraph {
  margin: .15rem 0;
}

.reading-derivation-chain .reading-formula-line {
  margin: 0;
  padding: .28rem .35rem;
  border: 0;
  background: transparent;
}

.reading-derivation-chain .reading-inline-choice-panel {
  margin: .15rem .35rem .45rem;
}

@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .reading-derivation-chain .reading-formula-line {
    padding: .42rem .45rem;
    font-size: 1rem;
  }

  .reading-derivation-chain .reading-inline-choice-panel {
    margin: 0 .45rem .55rem;
  }
}


.reading-formula-expression {
  display: flex;
  align-items: baseline;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: .08em;
  min-width: max-content;
}

.reading-formula-math,
.reading-formula-answer,
.reading-formula-text {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: baseline;
}

.reading-formula-choice {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  min-width: 3.15rem;
  min-height: 2rem;
  padding: .12rem .48rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-primary);
  background: #fff;
  color: var(--color-primary);
  font: inherit;
  line-height: 1;
  cursor: pointer;
}

.reading-formula-choice:hover,
.reading-formula-choice:focus-visible {
  background: #f2f6fa;
  outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.reading-formula-choice--wrong {
  border-color: var(--color-error);
  color: var(--color-error);
}

.reading-formula-answer {
  color: inherit;
}

.reading-formula-missing {
  display: inline-block;
  min-width: 1.8rem;
  color: var(--color-error);
}

.reading-choice-hint {
  display: grid;
  gap: .18rem;
  padding: .55rem .65rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-primary);
  background: #f6f3e9;
  font-size: .84rem;
  line-height: 1.55;
}

.reading-choice-hint strong {
  font-size: .72rem;
  letter-spacing: .04em;
}

.reading-choice-hint span {
  color: var(--color-text);
}


/* Math practice progressive reasoning figures */
.math-practice-figure {
  width: 100%;
  margin: .7rem 0 .95rem;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  background: var(--color-paper);
}
.math-practice-figure__title {
  padding: .42rem .62rem;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  color: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: .72rem;
  font-weight: 700;
}
.math-practice-figure__svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  max-height: 240px;
  color: var(--color-text);
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-line,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-shape,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-card,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-guide-line,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-emphasis-line,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-angle,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-tick,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-cross {
  vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-line {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--color-text);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-guide-line {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--color-muted);
  stroke-width: 1.25;
  stroke-dasharray: 4 4;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-emphasis-line {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--color-primary);
  stroke-width: 4;
  stroke-linecap: round;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-shape {
  fill: var(--color-bg);
  stroke: var(--color-text);
  stroke-width: 2;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-card {
  fill: var(--color-bg);
  stroke: var(--color-border);
  stroke-width: 1.5;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-angle,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-tick {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--color-primary);
  stroke-width: 2;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-cross {
  fill: none;
  stroke: var(--color-error);
  stroke-width: 2.25;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-open-dot {
  fill: var(--color-paper);
  stroke: var(--color-primary);
  stroke-width: 2;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-closed-dot,
.math-practice-figure .mpf-arrow {
  fill: var(--color-primary);
  stroke: var(--color-primary);
  stroke-width: 1;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-label {
  fill: var(--color-text);
  font-size: 12px;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-label--strong {
  font-weight: 700;
}
.math-practice-figure .mpf-muted {
  fill: var(--color-muted);
  font-size: 11px;
}
@media (max-width: 420px) {
  .math-practice-figure {
    margin-inline: 0;
  }
  .math-practice-figure__title {
    font-size: .68rem;
  }
  .math-practice-figure .mpf-label {
    font-size: 11px;
  }
  .math-practice-figure .mpf-muted {
    font-size: 10px;
  }
}


/* 2026-10-10 integration: previously published math textbook presentation; retain main math-practice CSS */
.textbook-unit-link--pending { cursor: default; opacity: .62; background: color-mix(in srgb, white 82%, var(--color-section)); box-shadow: none; }
.textbook-unit-link--pending:hover { border-color: var(--color-border); background: color-mix(in srgb, white 82%, var(--color-section)); box-shadow: none; }
.reading-role-marker { width: fit-content; margin: .85rem 0 -.25rem; color: var(--color-text); font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.4; }
.reading-role-marker--summary { margin-top: 1.2rem; font-size: 1.22rem; }
.reading-dialogue { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .25rem; margin: .2rem 0; padding: .55rem .7rem; background: #f3f3f3; color: var(--color-text); font-size: .9rem; line-height: 1.7; }
.reading-dialogue strong { color: var(--color-text); }
.reading-term { color: var(--color-text); font-weight: 800; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  [data-textbook-subject='math-1a'] .reading-choice-options { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* Math textbook "集合" view-only completion compacting.
   No academic text styling / mathematical source edits. */
/* W-MATH-002 P-002: one closed history row, not a pile of completed titles. */
.math-textbook-history { display: grid; gap: .45rem; min-width: 0; }
.math-textbook-history-toggle {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: .6rem;
  width: 100%; border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-text);
  padding: .55rem .7rem; font: inherit; font-size: .84rem;
  font-weight: 700; text-align: left; cursor: pointer;
}
.math-textbook-history-toggle:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.math-textbook-history-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px; }
.math-textbook-compact-flow { display: grid; gap: .65rem; min-width: 0; }
.math-textbook-stage { min-width: 0; scroll-margin-top: 1.5rem; }
.math-textbook-stage--current { display: grid; gap: .85rem; }
.math-textbook-stage--current > .reading-block-with-choice,
.math-textbook-stage--current > .reading-derivation-chain { min-width: 0; }
.math-textbook-stage-active-title {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between; gap: .5rem;
  padding: .7rem .75rem; border-left: 4px solid var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section); color: var(--color-text);
}
.math-textbook-stage-active-title strong { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 800; }
.math-textbook-stage-active-title small { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--color-muted); }
.math-textbook-stage--past { border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-paper); }
.math-textbook-stage-summary {
  display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  gap: .5rem; padding: .45rem .65rem;
}
.math-textbook-stage-summary__name {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: .35rem; min-width: 0;
  color: var(--color-text); font-weight: 700; font-size: .82rem;
}
.math-textbook-stage-summary__name svg { flex: 0 0 auto; color: var(--color-success); }
.math-textbook-stage-toggle, .math-textbook-expand-all,
.math-textbook-stage-reference button {
  padding: .3rem .5rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-border);
  color: var(--color-text); background: var(--color-paper);
  font: inherit; font-size: .78rem; cursor: pointer; text-decoration: underline;
}
.math-textbook-stage-toggle:hover, .math-textbook-expand-all:hover,
.math-textbook-stage-reference button:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); }
.math-textbook-stage-toggle:focus-visible, .math-textbook-expand-all:focus-visible,
.math-textbook-stage-reference button:focus-visible, .math-textbook-next-stage:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 2px;
}
.math-textbook-expand-all { justify-self: start; }
.math-textbook-stage-detail {
  display: grid; gap: .85rem; padding: .65rem .7rem 1rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-border);
}
.math-textbook-stage-references {
  display: grid; gap: .35rem; min-width: 0;
  padding: .55rem .65rem; border: 1px solid var(--color-line);
  background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-text);
  font-size: .82rem;
}
.math-textbook-stage-references__title { font-size: .8rem; color: var(--color-text); }
.math-textbook-stage-reference { min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; }
.math-textbook-stage-reference-content {
  min-width: 0; max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;
  padding: .25rem .4rem; border: 0; background: transparent;
}
.math-textbook-stage-reference-content .reading-formula-line {
  width: max-content; max-width: 100%; margin: 0;
  padding: .2rem .25rem; border: 0; background: transparent;
  text-align: left; font-size: 1rem;
}
.math-textbook-stage-reference-content .reading-paragraph { font-size: .86rem; line-height: 1.65; }
.math-textbook-stage-reference-content .reading-formula-line .katex,
.math-textbook-stage-reference-content .reading-paragraph .katex {
  font-size: 1em; /* Keep U, A, B, and their complements in one math style. */
}
.math-textbook-stage-reference-content--figure .reading-figure { padding: .4rem; border: 0; background: transparent; }
.math-textbook-stage-reference-content--figure .reading-figure img { max-height: 240px; }
@media (max-width: 640px) {
  .math-textbook-stage-reference-content--figure .reading-figure img { max-height: 180px; }
  .reading-choice-formula-line .katex { font-size: .9em; }
}

.math-textbook-stage-reference-content .reading-figure { margin: 0; }
.math-textbook-next-stage-panel {
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .6rem; padding: .7rem .8rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--color-border); background: var(--color-section);
}
.math-textbook-next-stage-panel span { color: var(--color-text); font-size: .83rem; }
.math-textbook-next-stage {
  border: 1px solid var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-primary);
  color: white; cursor: pointer; min-height: 40px; padding: .45rem 1.1rem; font-weight: 800;
}


/* W-MATH-006/P-001: established N02-style 選択 rectangle for N12 and linked R3 local blanks; keep 44px touch height. */
.reading-formula-choice--token {
  min-width: 3.15rem;
  min-height: 44px;
  padding: .12rem .48rem;
  border-width: 1px;
  border-radius: 0;
  font-size: inherit;
  font-weight: inherit;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
}
.reading-formula-choice--token:focus-visible {
  outline: 3px solid var(--color-primary);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.reading-formula-line:has(.reading-formula-choice--token) {
  max-width: 100%;
  overflow-x: auto;
}
.n12-progress-upgrade-note {
  margin: 0;
  padding: .7rem .85rem;
  border-left: 3px solid var(--color-primary);
  background: var(--color-section);
  color: var(--color-text);
  line-height: 1.7;
}


/* W-MATH-008/P-001 — N12 only: stacked mathematical transformations and intact
   token controls. Keep other textbook units' proven layout untouched. */
.reading-formula-line.reading-formula-line--n12 {
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  overflow-x: visible;
  white-space: normal;
}
.reading-formula-line--n12 .reading-formula-expression {
  min-width: 0;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100%;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  align-items: flex-end;
  column-gap: .14em;
  row-gap: .22rem;
}
.reading-formula-n12-transform {
  display: inline-flex;
  max-width: 100%;
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 0 1 auto;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: .12rem;
}

              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "四組をすべて確かめたら、出てきた順に足し合わせよう。"

                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "真ん中の二つが同じ文字の項でも、ここでは分けて残す。"

              "type": "formula",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "math",
                  "latex": "(5x+4y)^2="
                },
                {
                  "type": "choice",
                  "itemId": "n04-01"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "paragraph-n04-bridge",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "二項の平方では、両端の積だけでなく、異なる項どうしの掛け算も現れる。次は、その二つを一つにまとめる理由を考える。"
                }
              ]

            {
              "id": "n04-heading-1",
              "type": "heading",
              "text": "同じ平方から一般の乗法公式へ"

              "type": "marker",

              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "四組を計算できた。次に同じ文字の項をまとめ、具体例の構造を a、b に移そう。途中の組合せを飛ばさず、式を一行ずつ作る。"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-lead-02",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "四項のうち、5x と4yを掛けた交差項は二度現れた。両方を加えると何になるだろう。"
                },
                {
                  "type": "math",
                  "latex": "20xy+20xy"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-formula-02",
              "type": "formula",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "choice",
                  "itemId": "n04-02"

              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "交差項を一つだけ数えると中央が半分になってしまう。"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-lead-03",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "両端の平方項と、いままとめた中央の項を並べる。"
                },
                {
                  "type": "math",
                  "latex": "(5x+4y)^2"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-formula-03",
              "type": "formula",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "choice",
                  "itemId": "n04-03"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-after-03",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "単なる両端の二乗ではない。二つの括弧が同じなら中央の積が二組現れる。"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-show-n04-f01",
              "type": "figure",
              "figureId": "n04-f01"
            },

              "id": "n04-lead-04",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "原資料の四マスの表を使う。今度は5x、4yの代わりにa、bを入れ、掛けた順を保つ。"
                },
                {
                  "type": "math",
                  "latex": "(a+b)(a+b)"

              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-formula-04",
              "type": "formula",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "choice",
                  "itemId": "n04-04"
                }
              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-after-04",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "交差積abとbaはまだ二項のまま残す。"

              ]
            },
            {
              "id": "n04-lead-05",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "交換法則でba=abとなる。そこで中央の同類項だけを集めよう。"

                {
                  "type": "math",
                  "latex": "a^2+ab+ba+b^2"

              "id": "n04-formula-05",
              "type": "formula",
              "parts": [

                  "type": "choice",
                  "itemId": "n04-05"

              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "これが和の平方の公式であり、四つの積の計算から導かれた関係である。"

            },
            {
              "id": "n04-lead-06",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [
                {
                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "bの代わりに−bを入れると差の平方になる。交差項の負号をそのまま追う。"

                  "type": "math",
                  "latex": "(a-b)(a-b)"

                  "itemId": "n04-06"

              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [

                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "中央二項はどちらも負、最後の平方項は正になる。"

              "id": "n04-lead-07",
              "type": "paragraph",
              "parts": [

                  "type": "text",
                  "text": "二つの負の交差項をまとめ、差の平方の公式を導く。"

                  "latex": "a^2-ab-ba+b^2"
