      "source": "import { developmentFeedback } from '../data/textbook/math/numbers/developmentFeedback'\nimport { InlineMath } from 'react-katex'\nimport { Check, LockKeyhole, RotateCcw, X } from 'lucide-react'\nimport { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'\nimport { Link, useParams } from 'react-router-dom'\nimport { TextbookFigure } from '../components/textbook/TextbookFigure'\nimport { TextbookFormula } from '../components/textbook/TextbookFormula'\nimport { ErrorState, ProgressBar, RaisedButton, StatusBadge } from '../components/ui/Primitives'\nimport { textbookRepository } from '../repositories/textbookRepository'\nimport { effectiveTextbookProgress, getTextbookChoices, isTextbookItemResolved, normalizeTextbookAnswer, textbookSectionProgress, textbookUnitProgress, type TextbookAnswerRecord, type TextbookUnitProgress } from '../domain/textbook'\nimport type { TextbookItem, TextbookReadingBlock, TextbookReadingPart, TextbookSection, TextbookUnit } from '../domain/textbookSchema'\nimport { useAppStore } from '../stores/useAppStore'\nimport { useI18n } from '../i18n/runtime'\nimport { normalizeTextbookMath } from '../domain/textbookMath'\nimport { textbookDisplayLines } from '../domain/textbookDisplayLines'\nimport { chapter1ChunkForUnitCode, chapter1Localized, chapter1NextUnit } from '../data/textbook/ch01/chapter1Architecture'\nimport { mathTextbookNextUnitId, mathTextbookTopicForUnit } from '../data/textbook/math'\nimport { partitionMathSetReadingFlow, requiredMathSetContext } from '../data/textbook/math/presentation'\n\nfunction interactionPrompt(item: TextbookItem, text: (ja: string, zh: string) => string, subject: TextbookUnit['subject']) {\n  switch (item.purpose) {\n    case 'concept-formation': return text('図や本文から意味を考えよう。', '根据图和正文思考含义。')\n    case 'representation-link': return text('図・言葉・式のつながりを考えよう。', '思考图、文字和公式之间的联系。')\n    case 'definition': return text('意味から関係を作ろう。', '从含义出发建立关系。')\n    case 'solution-planning': return text('次に何を考えるべきか選ぼう。', '选择下一步应该思考什么。')\n    case 'transfer': return text('ここまでの考え方を使ってみよう。', '用前面学过的思路来判断。')\n    case 'relation-selection': return text('ここで使う関係を選ぼう。', '选择这里应该使用的关系。')\n    case 'physical-condition': return text('この場面で成り立つ物理条件を考えよう。', '思考这个情境下成立的物理条件。')\n    case 'graph-reading': return text('グラフが表している物理量を読もう。', '读取图像所表示的物理量。')\n    case 'elimination': return text('どの関係を使って変数を消すか考えよう。', '思考用哪个关系消去变量。')\n    case 'factorization': return text('次の式変形の意味を考えよう。', '思考下一步式变形的意义。')\n    case 'causal-reasoning': return subject === 'math-1a'\n      ? text('条件や理由のつながりをたどろう。', '沿着条件与理由的联系思考。')\n      : text('変化の因果関係をたどろう。', '沿着变化的因果关系思考。')\n    default: return item.prompt\n  }\n}\n\nfunction readingGroupItemIds(blocks: TextbookReadingBlock[], section: TextbookSection) {\n  return blocks.flatMap((block) => {\n    if (block.type === 'paragraph' || block.type === 'formula') {\n      return block.parts.filter((part) => part.type === 'choice').map((part) => part.itemId)\n    }\n    if (block.type === 'figure') {\n      return section.figures\n        .find((figure) => figure.id === block.figureId)\n        ?.overlays.filter((overlay) => overlay.interactive !== false).map((overlay) => overlay.itemId) ?? []\n    }\n    return []\n  })\n}\n\nfunction groupReadingFlow(blocks: TextbookReadingBlock[]) {\n  const groups: TextbookReadingBlock[][] = []\n  let current: TextbookReadingBlock[] = []\n\n  for (const block of blocks) {\n    if (block.type === 'heading' && current.some((candidate) => candidate.type === 'heading')) {\n      groups.push(current)\n      current = []\n    }\n    current.push(block)\n  }\n  if (current.length) groups.push(current)\n  return groups\n}\n\nfunction renderResolvedChoice(item: TextbookItem, record: TextbookAnswerRecord) {\n  return (\n    <span className=\"reading-inline-answer\" data-testid={`resolved-${item.id}`}>\n      {item.answerType === 'formula'\n        ? (() => {\n          const lines = textbookDisplayLines(item.id, record.value)\n          return lines.length > 1\n            ? <span className=\"reading-formula-n12-answer-lines\">\n                {lines.map((line, i) => <span key={i}><InlineMath math={normalizeTextbookMath(line)} /></span>)}\n              </span>\n            : <InlineMath math={normalizeTextbookMath(record.value)} />\n        })()\n        : <>{record.value}</>}\n    </span>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction renderActiveChoice(\n  item: TextbookItem,\n  isWrong: boolean,\n  onOpen: (itemId: string) => void,\n  text: (ja: string, zh: string) => string,\n) {\n  return (\n    <button\n      type=\"button\"\n      data-testid={`textbook-item-${item.id}`}\n      className={`reading-inline-blank${isWrong ? ' reading-inline-blank--wrong' : ''}`}\n      onClick={() => onOpen(item.id)}\n      aria-label={item.prompt}\n    >\n      {isWrong && <X size={14} aria-hidden=\"true\" />}\n      <strong>{isWrong ? text('もう一度', '重新选择') : text('選択', '选择')}</strong>\n    </button>\n  )\n}\n\nfunction renderPart(\n  part: TextbookReadingPart,\n  section: TextbookSection,\n  progress: TextbookUnitProgress | undefined,\n  onOpen: (itemId: string) => void,\n  text: (ja: string, zh: string) => string,\n): ReactNode {\n  if (part.type === 'text') return part.text\n  if (part.type === 'term') return <strong className=\"reading-term\">{part.text}</strong>\n  if (part.type === 'math') return <InlineMath math={part.latex} />\n\n  const item = section.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === part.itemId)\n  if (!item) return null\n  const record = progress?.answers[item.id]\n  if (isTextbookItemResolved(item, record)) return renderResolvedChoice(item, record!)\n  return renderActiveChoice(item, Boolean(record), onOpen, text)\n}\n\nexport function TextbookReadingFlow({ unit, section, progress, onSummaryReached, onReviewAnswer, reviewMarks }: {\n  unit: TextbookUnit\n  section: TextbookSection\n  progress: TextbookUnitProgress | undefined\n  onSummaryReached?: (reached: boolean) => void\n  /** Isolated preview: grade the real item without touching persisted learner progress. */\n  onReviewAnswer?: (item: TextbookItem, choice: string) => void\n  /** Never passed by the ordinary learner route; visual annotations only. */\n  reviewMarks?: Readonly<Record<string, number>>\n}) {\n  const { text, language } = useI18n()\n  const answerTextbook = useAppStore((state) => state.answerTextbook)\n  const [activeItemId, setActiveItemId] = useState<string | null>(null)\n  const groups = useMemo(() => groupReadingFlow(section.readingFlow), [section.readingFlow])\n  const currentProgress = progress?.unitRevision === unit.revision ? progress : undefined\n\n  const firstIncompleteGroup = groups.findIndex((group) => {\n    const itemIds = readingGroupItemIds(group, section)\n    return itemIds.length > 0 && itemIds.some((itemId) => {\n      const item = section.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === itemId)\n      return !item || !isTextbookItemResolved(item, currentProgress?.answers[itemId])\n    })\n  })\n  const visibleGroupCount = firstIncompleteGroup === -1 ? groups.length : firstIncompleteGroup + 1\n  const visibleGroups = groups.slice(0, visibleGroupCount)\n\n\n  // The published math-sets lesson alone uses explicitly authored presentation stages.\n  // This changes no readingFlow text, answer key, source order, image or stored progress.\n  const compactStages = useMemo(\n    () => unit.subject === 'math-1a' && unit.unitId === 'math-sets' && unit.status === 'published' && section.id === 'lesson'\n      ? partitionMathSetReadingFlow(section.readingFlow)\n      : null,\n    [unit.subject, unit.unitId, unit.status, section.id, section.readingFlow],\n  )\n  const [compactCursor, setCompactCursor] = useState(0)\n  const [showPastHistory, setShowPastHistory] = useState(false)\n  const [expandedPastStages, setExpandedPastStages] = useState<readonly string[]>([])\n  const [expandAllPast, setExpandAllPast] = useState(false)\n  const [expandedReference, setExpandedReference] = useState<string | null>(null)\n  const compactKey = 'math-textbook-compact-v1:' + unit.unitId + ':r' + unit.revision\n  const firstIncompleteCompactIndex = compactStages?.findIndex(stage => {\n    const itemIds = readingGroupItemIds([...stage.blocks], section)\n    return itemIds.some(id => {\n      const item = section.items.find(candidate => candidate.id === id)\n      return !item || !isTextbookItemResolved(item, currentProgress?.answers[id])\n    })\n  }) ?? -1\n  const maxAvailableCompactIndex = compactStages\n    ? firstIncompleteCompactIndex === -1 ? compactStages.length - 1 : firstIncompleteCompactIndex\n    : 0\n  const activeCompactIndex = Math.min(compactCursor, maxAvailableCompactIndex)\n  const allMathSetItemsResolved = compactStages !== null && currentProgress !== undefined &&\n    section.items.every(item => isTextbookItemResolved(item, currentProgress.answers[item.id]))\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!compactStages) return\n    const stored = window.localStorage.getItem(compactKey)\n    const candidate = stored !== null ? Number(stored) : Math.max(0, maxAvailableCompactIndex - 1)\n    const safe = Number.isInteger(candidate) && candidate >= 0\n      ? Math.min(candidate, maxAvailableCompactIndex)\n      : 0\n    // A reset may make the saved stage unreachable; discard that stale cursor.\n    if (stored !== null && Number(stored) > maxAvailableCompactIndex) {\n      window.localStorage.setItem(compactKey, String(safe))\n    }\n    setCompactCursor(safe)\n  }, [compactKey, maxAvailableCompactIndex, compactStages])\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (compactStages) {\n      onSummaryReached?.(allMathSetItemsResolved && activeCompactIndex === compactStages.length - 1)\n    }\n  }, [compactStages, activeCompactIndex, allMathSetItemsResolved, onSummaryReached])\n\n  const goToNextCompactStage = () => {\n    if (!compactStages) return\n    const next = Math.min(activeCompactIndex + 1, maxAvailableCompactIndex)\n    setCompactCursor(next)\n    setShowPastHistory(false)\n    setExpandedReference(null)\n    setExpandedPastStages([])\n    setExpandAllPast(false)\n    window.localStorage.setItem(compactKey, String(next))\n    window.requestAnimationFrame(() => {\n      const nextSection = document.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[data-testid=\"math-textbook-stage-' + compactStages[next].id + '\"]')\n      nextSection?.focus({ preventScroll: true })\n      nextSection?.scrollIntoView({ block: 'start', behavior: 'auto' })\n    })\n  }\n\n  const activeItem = activeItemId ? section.items.find((item) => item.id === activeItemId) : undefined\n  const activeRecord = activeItem ? currentProgress?.answers[activeItem.id] : undefined\n  const activeChoices = activeItem ? getTextbookChoices(unit, activeItem) : []\n  // Wide mathematical alternatives must not be forced into two narrow cards.\n  // This is a presentation-only decision; original answer/choice strings are preserved.\n  const wideMathChoices = unit.subject === 'math-1a'\n    && activeItem?.answerType === 'formula'\n    && activeChoices.some(choice => choice.length > 27 || choice.includes('\\\\quad'))\n  const activeHint = activeItem && activeRecord && !isTextbookItemResolved(activeItem, activeRecord) && activeRecord.attemptCount > 0 && activeItem.hints.length\n    ? [developmentFeedback(activeItem.id, activeRecord.value), activeItem.hints[Math.min(activeRecord.attemptCount - 1, activeItem.hints.length - 1)]].filter(Boolean).join(' ')\n    : undefined\n  const continuousLesson = unit.sections.length === 1 && section.id === 'lesson'\n\n  const visibleBlocksInGroup = (group: TextbookReadingBlock[]) => {\n    const firstBlockedIndex = group.findIndex((block) => {\n      const itemIds = readingGroupItemIds([block], section)\n      return itemIds.some((itemId) => {\n        const item = section.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === itemId)\n        return !item || !isTextbookItemResolved(item, currentProgress?.answers[itemId])\n      })\n    })\n    return firstBlockedIndex === -1 ? group : group.slice(0, firstBlockedIndex + 1)\n  }\n\n  const selectChoice = (choice: string) => {\n    if (!activeItem || isTextbookItemResolved(activeItem, activeRecord)) return\n    if (onReviewAnswer) onReviewAnswer(activeItem, choice)\n    else answerTextbook(unit, activeItem.id, choice)\n    setActiveItemId(null)\n  }\n\n  const blockContainsActiveItem = (block: TextbookReadingBlock) => {\n    if (!activeItemId) return false\n    if (block.type === 'paragraph' || block.type === 'formula') {\n      return block.parts.some((part) => part.type === 'choice' && part.itemId === activeItemId)\n    }\n    if (block.type === 'figure') {\n      return Boolean(\n        section.figures\n          .find((figure) => figure.id === block.figureId)\n          ?.overlays.some((overlay) => overlay.itemId === activeItemId),\n      )\n    }\n    return false\n  }\n\n  const renderInlineChoicePanel = (block: TextbookReadingBlock) => {\n    if (!activeItem || !blockContainsActiveItem(block)) return null\n    return (\n      <div className=\"reading-inline-choice-panel\" data-testid={`inline-choice-panel-${activeItem.id}`}>\n        <div className=\"reading-inline-choice-panel__head\">\n          <span>{interactionPrompt(activeItem, text, unit.subject)}</span>\n        </div>\n        {activeHint && (\n          <div className=\"reading-choice-hint\" data-testid={`textbook-hint-${activeItem.id}`}>\n            <strong>{text('ヒント', '提示')}</strong>\n            <span>{activeHint}</span>\n          </div>\n        )}\n        <div\n          className={`reading-choice-options${wideMathChoices ? ' reading-choice-options--math-wide' : ''}`}\n          role=\"group\"\n          aria-label={interactionPrompt(activeItem, text, unit.subject)}\n        >\n          {activeChoices.map((choice, index) => {\n            const isLastWrongChoice = unit.subject === 'math-1a'\n              && Boolean(activeRecord)\n              && !isTextbookItemResolved(activeItem, activeRecord)\n              && normalizeTextbookAnswer(choice) === normalizeTextbookAnswer(activeRecord?.value ?? '')\n            return (\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              aria-label={choice}\n              aria-invalid={isLastWrongChoice || undefined}\n              key={choice}\n              data-testid={`textbook-choice-${activeItem.id}-${index}`}\n              className={`reading-choice-option${isLastWrongChoice ? ' reading-choice-option--wrong' : ''}`}\n              onClick={() => selectChoice(choice)}\n            >\n              <span>{index + 1}</span>\n              <strong>\n                {activeItem.answerType === 'formula'\n                  ? (\n                    <span className=\"reading-choice-formula-lines\">\n                      {textbookDisplayLines(activeItem.id, choice).flatMap(value => value.split('\\\\quad')).map((line, lineIndex) => (\n                        <span className=\"reading-choice-formula-line\" key={lineIndex}>\n                          <InlineMath math={normalizeTextbookMath(line.trim())} />\n                        </span>\n                      ))}\n                    </span>\n                  )\n                  : choice}\n              </strong>\n              {activeItem.unit && <small>{activeItem.unit}</small>}\n            </button>\n            )\n          })}\n        </div>\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const renderBlock = (block: TextbookReadingBlock) => {\n    if (block.type === 'heading') return <h3 className=\"reading-subheading\" key={block.id}>{block.text}</h3>\n    if (block.type === 'marker') {\n      return (\n        <div\n          className={`reading-role-marker reading-role-marker--${block.kind}`}\n          data-testid={`reading-role-${block.kind}-${block.id}`}\n          key={block.id}\n        >\n          {block.text}\n        </div>\n      )\n    }\n    if (block.type === 'dialogue') {\n      const speaker = block.speaker === 'hanako'\n        ? text('花子', '花子')\n        : block.speaker === 'taro'\n          ? text('太郎', '太郎')\n          : text('先生', '老师')\n      return (\n        <aside className=\"reading-dialogue\" data-speaker={block.speaker} key={block.id}>\n          <strong>{speaker}：</strong>\n          <span>「{block.text}」</span>\n        </aside>\n      )\n    }\n    if (block.type === 'note') return <aside className=\"reading-note\" key={block.id}>{block.text}</aside>\n\n    if (block.type === 'figure') {\n      const figure = section.figures.find((candidate) => candidate.id === block.figureId)\n      if (!figure) return null\n      return (\n        <div className=\"reading-block-with-choice\" key={block.id}>\n          <TextbookFigure figure={figure} items={section.items} progress={currentProgress} onOpen={setActiveItemId} />\n          {renderInlineChoicePanel(block)}\n        </div>\n      )\n    }\n\n    if (block.type === 'formula') {\n      return (\n        <div className=\"reading-block-with-choice\" key={block.id}>\n          <TextbookFormula block={block} section={section} progress={currentProgress} onOpen={setActiveItemId} unitId={unit.unitId} />\n          {renderInlineChoicePanel(block)}\n        </div>\n      )\n    }\n\n    const content = block.parts.map((part, index) => (\n      <span key={`${block.id}-part-${index}`}>\n        {renderPart(part, section, currentProgress, setActiveItemId, text)}\n      </span>\n    ))\n\n    return (\n      <div className=\"reading-block-with-choice\" key={block.id}>\n        <p className=\"reading-paragraph\">{content}</p>\n        {renderInlineChoicePanel(block)}\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const renderBlockWithReviewMark = (block: TextbookReadingBlock) => {\n    const mark = reviewMarks?.[block.id]\n    if (!mark) return renderBlock(block)\n    return (\n      <div className=\"review-marked-block\" data-testid={`review-mark-${block.id}`} key={block.id}>\n        <span className=\"review-marked-block__label\" aria-label={`確認 ${mark}`}>\n          確認{String.fromCharCode(0x2460 + mark - 1)}\n        </span>\n        {renderBlock(block)}\n      </div>\n    )\n  }\n\n  const renderVisibleBlocks = (blocks: TextbookReadingBlock[]) => {\n    const rendered: ReactNode[] = []\n    let index = 0\n\n    while (index < blocks.length) {\n      const block = blocks[index]\n      const derivationId =\n        block.type === 'paragraph' || block.type === 'formula' || block.type === 'note'\n          ? block.derivationId\n          : undefined\n\n      if (derivationId) {\n        const run: TextbookReadingBlock[] = []\n        while (index < blocks.length) {\n          const candidate = blocks[index]\n          const candidateId =\n            candidate.type === 'paragraph' || candidate.type === 'formula' || candidate.type === 'note'\n              ? candidate.derivationId\n              : undefined\n          if (candidateId !== derivationId) break\n          run.push(candidate)\n          index += 1\n        }\n\n        rendered.push(\n          <div className=\"reading-derivation-chain\" data-derivation-id={derivationId} key={`derivation-${derivationId}`}>\n            {run.map((entry) => (\n              <div\n                className={`reading-derivation-step reading-derivation-step--${entry.type}`}\n                key={entry.id}\n              >\n                {renderBlockWithReviewMark(entry)}\n              </div>\n            ))}\n          </div>,\n        )\n        continue\n      }\n\n      rendered.push(renderBlockWithReviewMark(block))\n      index += 1\n    }\n\n    return rendered\n  }\n\n  return (\n    <article className=\"textbook-reading-flow\" data-testid=\"textbook-reading-flow\" tabIndex={unit.unitId === 'math-numbers-expressions-n12' ? -1 : undefined}>\n      {compactStages ? (\n        <div className=\"math-textbook-compact-flow\" data-testid=\"math-textbook-compact-flow\">\n          {activeCompactIndex > 0 && (\n            <div className=\"math-textbook-history\">\n              <button\n                type=\"button\"\n                className=\"math-textbook-history-toggle\"\n                data-testid=\"math-textbook-history-toggle\"\n                aria-expanded={showPastHistory}\n                onClick={() => {\n                  setShowPastHistory(value => !value)\n                  setExpandAllPast(false)\n                  setExpandedPastStages([])\n                }}\n              >\n                <span>{text('これまでの学習', '之前的学习')}（{activeCompactIndex}{text('段階', '阶段')}）</span>\n                <span aria-hidden=\"true\">{showPastHistory ? '▲' : '▼'}</span>\n              </button>\n              {showPastHistory && (\n                <button\n                  type=\"button\"\n                  className=\"math-textbook-expand-all\"\n                  data-testid=\"math-textbook-expand-all\"\n                  aria-expanded={expandAllPast}\n                  onClick={() => setExpandAllPast(value => !value)}\n                >\n                  {expandAllPast ? text('過去の学習を閉じる', '收起之前的学习') : text('過去の学習をすべて見る', '查看全部已学内容')}\n                </button>\n              )}\n            </div>\n          )}\n          {compactStages.map((stage, index) => {\n            if (index > activeCompactIndex || (index < activeCompactIndex && !showPastHistory)) return null\n            const completedBefore = index < activeCompactIndex\n            const expanded = expandAllPast || expandedPastStages.includes(stage.id)\n            const stageItemIds = readingGroupItemIds([...stage.blocks], section)\n            const currentQuestionId = stageItemIds.find(id => {\n              const item = section.items.find(candidate => candidate.id === id)\n              return !item || !isTextbookItemResolved(item, currentProgress?.answers[id])\n            }) ?? null\n            const neededContextIds = completedBefore ? [] : requiredMathSetContext(currentQuestionId)\n            const stageAnswered = stageItemIds.every(id => {\n              const item = section.items.find(candidate => candidate.id === id)\n              return Boolean(item && isTextbookItemResolved(item, currentProgress?.answers[id]))\n            })\n            return (\n              <section\n                key={stage.id}\n                className={'math-textbook-stage' + (completedBefore ? ' math-textbook-stage--past' : ' math-textbook-stage--current')}\n                data-testid={'math-textbook-stage-' + stage.id}\n                tabIndex={completedBefore ? undefined : -1}\n              >\n                {completedBefore ? (\n                  <>\n                    <div className=\"math-textbook-stage-summary\">\n                      <span className=\"math-textbook-stage-summary__name\">\n                        <Check size={16} aria-hidden=\"true\" />\n                        {stage.label[language]}\n                      </span>\n                      <button\n                        type=\"button\"\n                        className=\"math-textbook-stage-toggle\"\n                        data-testid={'math-textbook-toggle-' + stage.id}\n                        aria-expanded={expanded}\n                        aria-controls={'math-textbook-stage-detail-' + stage.id}\n                        onClick={() => setExpandedPastStages(current => current.includes(stage.id)\n                          ? current.filter(id => id !== stage.id)\n                          : [...current, stage.id])}\n                      >\n                        {expanded ? text('閉じる', '收起') : text('全文を見る', '查看全文')}\n                      </button>\n                    </div>\n                    {expanded && (\n                      <div className=\"math-textbook-stage-detail\" id={'math-textbook-stage-detail-' + stage.id}>\n                        {renderVisibleBlocks([...stage.blocks])}\n                      </div>\n                    )}\n                  </>\n                ) : (\n                  <>\n                    <header className=\"math-textbook-stage-active-title\">\n                      <strong>{stage.label[language]}</strong>\n                      <small>{index + 1} / {compactStages.length}</small>\n                    </header>\n                    {neededContextIds.length > 0 && (\n                      <div className=\"math-textbook-stage-references\" data-testid=\"math-textbook-stage-references\" data-for-item={currentQuestionId ?? undefined}>\n                        <strong className=\"math-textbook-stage-references__title\">{text('この問題で使う条件', '本题需要的条件')}</strong>\n                        {neededContextIds.map(blockId => {\n                          const source = section.readingFlow.find(block => block.id === blockId)\n                          if (!source) return null\n                          const isFigure = source.type === 'figure'\n                          const open = expandedReference === blockId\n                          return (\n                            <div className=\"math-textbook-stage-reference\" key={blockId} data-testid={'math-textbook-context-' + blockId}>\n                              {isFigure ? (\n                                // This pre-existing, already-learned complement diagram is necessary\n                                // for d08–d10. Keep other figures optional to avoid long pages.\n                                blockId === 'figure-d-complement' ? (\n                                  <div className=\"math-textbook-stage-reference-content math-textbook-stage-reference-content--figure\" data-testid={'math-textbook-reference-' + blockId}>\n                                    {renderBlock(source)}\n                                  </div>\n                                ) : (\n                                  <>\n                                    <button\n                                      type=\"button\"\n                                      data-testid={'math-textbook-reference-' + blockId}\n                                      aria-expanded={open}\n                                      onClick={() => setExpandedReference(open ? null : blockId)}\n                                    >\n                                      {open ? text('図を閉じる', '收起图形') : text('前に学んだ図を見る', '查看之前学过的图形')}\n                                    </button>\n                                    {open && <div className=\"math-textbook-stage-reference-content\">{renderBlock(source)}</div>}\n                                  </>\n                                )\n                              ) : (\n                                <div className=\"math-textbook-stage-reference-content\" data-testid={'math-textbook-reference-' + blockId}>\n                                  {renderBlock(source)}\n                                </div>\n                              )}\n                            </div>\n                          )\n                        })}\n                      </div>\n                    )}\n                    {renderVisibleBlocks(visibleBlocksInGroup([...stage.blocks]))}\n                    {stageAnswered && index < compactStages.length -       "source": "import type { CSSProperties } from 'react'\nimport { isTextbookItemResolved, type TextbookUnitProgress } from '../../domain/textbook'\nimport type { TextbookFigure as TextbookFigureData, TextbookItem } from '../../domain/textbookSchema'\n\nfunction resolveAssetSrc(src: string) {\n  if (/^(?:https?:|data:|blob:)/i.test(src)) return src\n  // Vite statically replaces the *direct* import.meta.env.BASE_URL expression in production.\n  // Optional chaining on import.meta.env prevented reliable GitHub Pages asset prefixes.\n  const viteBase = import.meta.env.BASE_URL\n  const base = viteBase.endsWith('/') ? viteBase : `${viteBase}/`\n  if (src.startsWith(base)) return src\n  return `${base}${src.replace(/^\\.?\\/+/, '')}`\n}\n\ntype TextbookFigureProps = {\n  figure: TextbookFigureData\n  items: TextbookItem[]\n  progress: TextbookUnitProgress | undefined\n  onOpen: (itemId: string) => void\n}\n\nexport function TextbookFigure({ figure, items, progress, onOpen }: TextbookFigureProps) {\n  // The 11 approved SVG sources have viewBox only, with 640x360 Venn and\n  // 720x220 number-line layouts. Explicit <img> dimensions prevent zero-size\n  // intrinsic layout on Chromium while the CSS still scales to narrow screens.\n  const mathSetSvg = figure.src.startsWith('/assets/math/textbook/sets/') && figure.src.endsWith('.svg')\n  const numberLineSvg = mathSetSvg && figure.src.includes('/number-line-')\n  return (\n    <figure className=\"reading-figure\" data-testid={`textbook-figure-${figure.id}`}>\n      <div className={`textbook-figure-stage${mathSetSvg ? ' textbook-figure-stage--math-set-svg' : ''}`}>\n        <img src={resolveAssetSrc(figure.src)} alt={figure.alt} width={mathSetSvg ? (numberLineSvg ? 720 : 640) : undefined} height={mathSetSvg ? (numberLineSvg ? 220 : 360) : undefined} />\n        {figure.overlays.map((overlay) => {\n          const item = items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === overlay.itemId)\n          const record = progress?.answers[overlay.itemId]\n          const revealed = overlay.reveal === 'always' || Boolean(item && isTextbookItemResolved(item, record))\n          if (revealed) return null\n\n          const style = {\n            left: `${overlay.x}%`,\n            top: `${overlay.y}%`,\n            width: `${overlay.width}%`,\n            height: `${overlay.height}%`,\n          } satisfies CSSProperties\n\n          if (overlay.interactive === false) {\n            return (\n              <span\n                key={overlay.id}\n                className={`textbook-figure-overlay textbook-figure-overlay--${overlay.mode}`}\n                style={style}\n                data-testid={`textbook-figure-overlay-${overlay.id}`}\n                aria-hidden=\"true\"\n              >\n                <span aria-hidden=\"true\">?</span>\n              </span>\n            )\n          }\n\n          return (\n            <button\n              type=\"button\"\n              key={overlay.id}\n              className={`textbook-figure-overlay textbook-figure-overlay--${overlay.mode}`}\n              style={style}\n              data-testid={`textbook-figure-overlay-${overlay.id}`}\n              aria-label={overlay.ariaLabel ?? item?.prompt ?? item?.label ?? overlay.itemId}\n              onClick={() => onOpen(overlay.itemId)}\n            >\n              <span aria-hidden=\"true\">?</span>\n            </button>\n          )\n        })}\n      </div>\n      {figure.caption && <figcaption>{figure.caption}</figcaption>}\n    </figure>\n  )\n}\n"

      "source": "import { InlineMath } from 'react-katex'\nimport { auditedResolvedWrapBlocks, auditedWrapBlocks, formulaWrapChunks } from './formulaWrap'\nimport type { TextbookUnitProgress } from '../../domain/textbook'\nimport { isTextbookItemResolved } from '../../domain/textbook'\nimport { normalizeTextbookMath } from '../../domain/textbookMath'\nimport { textbookDisplayLines } from '../../domain/textbookDisplayLines'\nimport type { TextbookReadingBlock, TextbookSection } from '../../domain/textbookSchema'\n\ntype FormulaBlock = Extract<TextbookReadingBlock, { type: 'formula' }>\n\ntype Props = {\n  unitId: string\n  block: FormulaBlock\n  section: TextbookSection\n  progress: TextbookUnitProgress | undefined\n  onOpen: (itemId: string) => void\n}\n\n// Display-only: one solved coefficient of 1 immediately before the simple factor x+….\n// Keep the recorded answer as \"1\" and leave constants and other algebraic forms untouched.\nfunction isSolvedUnitCoefficientBeforeX(\n  block: FormulaBlock,\n  index: number,\n  section: TextbookSection,\n  progress: TextbookUnitProgress | undefined,\n): boolean {\n  const part = block.parts[index]\n  const next = block.parts[index + 1]\n  if (part?.type !== 'choice' || next?.type !== 'math' || !/^x\\+/.test(next.latex)) return false\n\n  const item = section.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === part.itemId)\n  if (!item || item.answerType !== 'formula') return false\n\n  const record = progress?.answers[item.id]\n  return isTextbookItemResolved(item, record) && (record?.value ?? item.answer) === '1'\n}\n\nexport function TextbookFormula({ block, section, progress, onOpen, unitId }: Props) {\n  const n12Formula = unitId === 'math-numbers-expressions-n12'\n  const renderedParts = block.parts.map((part, index) => {\n    const key = `${block.id}-part-${index}`\n\n    if (part.type === 'math') {\n      const followsUnitCoefficient = isSolvedUnitCoefficientBeforeX(block, index - 1, section, progress)\n      const latex = followsUnitCoefficient ? part.latex.slice(1) : part.latex\n      const arrow = '\\\\quad\\\\Longrightarrow\\\\quad'\n      const arrowAt = n12Formula ? latex.indexOf(arrow) : -1\n      if (arrowAt >= 0) {\n        const left = latex.slice(0, arrowAt)\n        const right = latex.slice(arrowAt + arrow.length)\n        return (\n          <span className=\"reading-formula-n12-transform\" key={key}>\n            {left && <span className=\"reading-formula-math\"><InlineMath math={left} /></span>}\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-n12-arrow\" aria-label=\"次の式へ\">↓</span>\n            {right && <span className=\"reading-formula-math\"><InlineMath math={right} /></span>}\n          </span>\n        )\n      }\n      return <span className=\"reading-formula-math\" key={key}><InlineMath math={latex} /></span>\n    }\n\n    if (part.type === 'text') {\n      return <span className=\"reading-formula-text\" key={key}>{part.text}</span>\n    }\n\n    if (part.type === 'term') {\n      return <strong className=\"reading-term reading-formula-term\" key={key}>{part.text}</strong>\n    }\n\n    const item = section.items.find((candidate) => candidate.id === part.itemId)\n    if (!item) {\n      return <span className=\"reading-formula-missing\" key={key}>□</span>\n    }\n\n    const record = progress?.answers[item.id]\n    const resolved = isTextbookItemResolved(item, record)\n\n    if (resolved) {\n      const value = record?.value ?? item.answer\n      const showCoefficientAsX = isSolvedUnitCoefficientBeforeX(block, index, section, progress)\n      return (\n        <span\n          className=\"reading-formula-answer\"\n          data-testid={`resolved-${item.id}`}\n          aria-label={showCoefficientAsX ? '係数は1（式ではx）' : undefined}\n          key={key}\n        >\n          {item.answerType === 'formula'\n            ? (() => {\n              const lines = textbookDisplayLines(item.id, value)\n              return lines.length > 1\n                ? <span className=\"reading-formula-n12-answer-lines\">\n                    {lines.map((line, i) =>\n                      <span key={i}><InlineMath math={normalizeTextbookMath(line)} /></span>)}\n                  </span>\n                : <InlineMath math={showCoefficientAsX ? 'x' : normalizeTextbookMath(lines[0])} />\n            })()\n            : value}\n        </span>\n      )\n    }\n\n    const wrong = Boolean(record)\n    const localToken = ['n12-p002-', 'n12-p003-', 'n09-p001-', 'n01-r3-', 'n03-r3-'].some(prefix => item.id.startsWith(prefix))\n    return (\n      <button\n        type=\"button\"\n        className={`reading-formula-choice${wrong ? ' reading-formula-choice--wrong' : ''}${localToken ? ' reading-formula-choice--token' : ''}`}\n        data-testid={`textbook-item-${item.id}`}\n        aria-label={item.prompt}\n        onClick={() => onOpen(item.id)}\n        key={key}\n      >\n        {wrong ? '×' : '選択'}\n      </button>\n    )\n  })\n  const first = block.parts[0]\n  const n12Choice = block.parts[1]\n  const suffix = block.parts[2]\n  const q06Layout = n12Formula && block.parts.length === 3 && block.id === 'formula-q06-left-coef'\n    && first?.type === 'math' && first.latex.endsWith('\\\\quad\\\\Longrightarrow\\\\quad')\n    && n12Choice?.type === 'choice' && n12Choice.itemId === 'n12-p002-q06-left-coef'\n    && suffix?.type === 'math'\n  const q12Layout = n12Formula && block.parts.length === 3 && block.id === 'formula-q12-signed-coef'\n    && first?.type === 'math' && first.latex.includes('=')\n    && n12Choice?.type === 'choice' && n12Choice.itemId === 'n12-p002-q12-signed-coef'\n    && suffix?.type === 'math'\n  const transformLayout = n12Formula && block.parts.length === 3\n    && ((block.id === 'formula-q02-coef' && n12Choice?.type === 'choice' && n12Choice.itemId === 'n12-p002-q02-coef')\n      || (block.id === 'formula-q06-right-coef' && n12Choice?.type === 'choice' && n12Choice.itemId === 'n12-p002-q06-right-coef'))\n    && first?.type === 'math' && first.latex.endsWith('\\\\quad\\\\Longrightarrow\\\\quad') && suffix?.type === 'math'\n  const puddingLayout = n12Formula && block.id === 'formula-cost-pudding' && block.parts.length === 3\n    && first?.type === 'math' && first.latex === '130\\\\times(20-x)='\n    && n12Choice?.type === 'choice' && n12Choice.itemId === 'n12-p003-q10-pudding-coef'\n    && suffix?.type === 'math' && suffix.latex === '(20-x)'\n  const lowerLayout = n12Formula && block.id === 'formula-q13-lower' && block.parts.length === 2\n    && first?.type === 'choice' && first.itemId === 'n12-p002-q13-lower'\n    && n12Choice?.type === 'math' && n12Choice.latex === '\\\\le50x<3300-2650'\n  const auditedWrap = auditedWrapBlocks[unitId]?.includes(block.id) ?? false\n  const wrapBlock = auditedWrap ? {\n    ...block,\n    parts: block.parts.map((part, index) => {\n      if (part.type !== 'choice' || !auditedResolvedWrapBlocks.includes(block.id)) return part\n      const item = section.items.find(q => q.id === part.itemId)\n      const record = progress?.answers[part.itemId]\n      return item && isTextbookItemResolved(item, record)\n        ? { type: 'math' as const, latex: `§a${index}§${normalizeTextbookMath(record?.value ?? item.answer)}§z${index}§` }\n        : part\n    }),\n  } : block\n  let wrappedAnswer: number | undefined\n  const markedAnswers = new Set<number>()\n  const grouped = q06Layout || q12Layout || transformLayout || puddingLayout\n  return (\n    <div\n      className={`reading-formula-line${n12Formula ? ' reading-formula-line--n12' : ''}`}\n      data-testid={`textbook-formula-${block.id}`}\n      data-latex-status=\"ok\"\n    >\n      <div className={`reading-formula-expression${grouped ? ' reading-formula-expression--p016' : ''}${lowerLayout ? ' reading-formula-expression--p017-chain' : ''}${auditedWrap ? ' reading-formula-expression--chapter-wrap' : ''}`}>\n        {(q06Layout || transformLayout) && first?.type === 'math' ? (\n          <>\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-group\" data-testid=\"p016-left\">\n              <InlineMath math={first.latex.slice(0, first.latex.indexOf('\\\\quad\\\\Longrightarrow\\\\quad'))} />\n            </span>\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-p016-arrow\" aria-label=\"次の式へ\">\n              <span className=\"reading-formula-p016-wide\" aria-hidden=\"true\">⇒</span>\n              <span className=\"reading-formula-p016-narrow\" aria-hidden=\"true\">↓</span>\n            </span>\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-group\" data-testid=\"p016-right\">\n              {renderedParts.slice(1)}\n            </span>\n          </>\n        ) : (q12Layout || puddingLayout) && first?.type === 'math' ? (\n          <>\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-group\" data-testid=\"p016-left\">\n              <InlineMath math={first.latex.slice(0, first.latex.indexOf('='))} />\n            </span>\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-group\" data-testid=\"p016-right\">\n              <InlineMath math={first.latex.slice(first.latex.indexOf('='))} />\n              {renderedParts.slice(1)}\n            </span>\n          </>\n        ) : lowerLayout ? (\n          <>\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-p017-bound\" data-testid=\"p017-bound\">\n              {renderedParts[0]}<span className=\"reading-formula-math\"><InlineMath math={'\\\\le50x'} /></span>\n            </span>\n            <span className=\"reading-formula-math reading-formula-p017-continuation\" data-testid=\"p017-continuation\"><InlineMath math=\"<3300-2650\" /></span>\n          </>\n        ) : auditedWrap ? formulaWrapChunks(wrapBlock).map((chunk, groupIndex) => (\n          <span className=\"reading-formula-wrap-group\" key={`${block.id}-wrap-${groupIndex}`}>\n            {chunk.split(/(§(?:\\d+|a\\d+|z\\d+)§)/).filter(Boolean).map((part, partIndex) => {\n              const begin = part.match(/^§a(\\d+)§$/)\n              if (begin) { wrappedAnswer = Number(begin[1]); return null }\n              if (/^§z\\d+§$/.test(part)) { wrappedAnswer = undefined; return null }\n              const choice = part.match(/^§(\\d+)§$/)\n              const answerPart = wrappedAnswer === undefined ? undefined : block.parts[wrappedAnswer]\n              const answerId = answerPart?.type === 'choice' && !markedAnswers.has(wrappedAnswer!) ? answerPart.itemId : undefined\n              if (answerId) markedAnswers.add(wrappedAnswer!)\n              return choice ? renderedParts[Number(choice[1])]\n                : <span className=\"reading-formula-math\" data-testid={answerId ? `resolved-${answerId}` : undefined} key={`${block.id}-wrap-${groupIndex}-${partIndex}`}><InlineMath math={part} /></span>\n            })}\n          </span>\n        )) : renderedParts}\n      </div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"

      "path": "src/components/ui/Primitives.tsx",

      "bytes": 5079,
      "usedByRendererBundle": true,
      "source": "import { useEffect, useRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent, type ReactNode } from 'react'\nimport { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, Info, X } from 'lucide-react'\nimport { useI18n } from '../../i18n/runtime'\n\nexport function NumberedSection({ number, title, children, description }: { number: string; title: string; children: ReactNode; description?: string }) {\n  return (\n    <section className=\"numbered-section\">\n      <header className=\"section-heading\"><span>{number}</span><div><h2>{title}</h2>{description && <p>{description}</p>}</div></header>\n      <div className=\"section-body\">{children}</div>\n    </section>\n  )\n}\n\nexport function RaisedButton({ className = '', ...props }: ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>) {\n  return <button type=\"button\" className={`raised-button ${className}`} {...props} />\n}\n\nfunction useModalFocus(open: boolean, onEscape: () => void) {\n  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null)\n  useEffect(() => {\n    if (!open) return\n    const previous = document.activeElement instanceof HTMLElement ? document.activeElement : null\n    const frame = window.requestAnimationFrame(() => ref.current?.querySelector<HTMLElement>('button, input, select, textarea, [href]')?.focus())\n    return () => { window.cancelAnimationFrame(frame); previous?.focus() }\n  }, [open])\n  const onKeyDown = (event: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {\n    if (event.key === 'Escape') { event.preventDefault(); onEscape(); return }\n    if (event.key !== 'Tab' || !ref.current) return\n    const focusable = [...ref.current.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>('button:not(:disabled), input:not(:disabled), select:not(:disabled), textarea:not(:disabled), [href]')]\n    if (!focusable.length) return\n    const first = focusable[0]\n    const last = focusable.at(-1)!\n    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { event.preventDefault(); last.focus() }\n    else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { event.preventDefault(); first.focus() }\n  }\n  return { ref, onKeyDown }\n}\n\nexport function StatusBadge({ tone = 'info', children }: { tone?: 'info' | 'success' | 'error' | 'muted'; children: ReactNode }) {\n  const Icon = tone === 'success' ? CheckCircle2 : tone === 'error' ? AlertTriangle : Info\n  return <span className={`status-badge status-badge--${tone}`}><Icon size={15} aria-hidden=\"true\" />{children}</span>\n}\n\nexport function ProgressBar({ value, max, label }: { value: number; max: number; label: string }) {\n  const safeMax = Math.max(max, 1)\n  const percent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (value / safeMax) * 100))\n  return (\n    <div className=\"progress-block\">\n      <div className=\"progress-label\"><span>{label}</span><span>{value}/{max}</span></div>\n      <div className=\"progress-track\" role=\"progressbar\" aria-label={label} aria-valuemin={0} aria-valuemax={max} aria-valuenow={value}><span style={{ width: `${percent}%` }} /></div>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport function EmptyState({ title, body, action }: { title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode }) {\n  return <div className=\"state-panel\"><span className=\"state-panel__mark\">—</span><h2>{title}</h2><p>{body}</p>{action}</div>\n}\n\nexport function ErrorState({ title, body, action }: { title: string; body: string; action?: ReactNode }) {\n  return <div className=\"state-panel state-panel--error\"><AlertTriangle aria-hidden=\"true\" /><h2>{title}</h2><p>{body}</p>{action}</div>\n}\n\nexport function BottomSheet({ open, title, onClose, children }: { open: boolean; title: string; onClose: () => void; children: ReactNode }) {\n  const { text } = useI18n()\n  const modal = useModalFocus(open, onClose)\n  if (!open) return null\n  return (\n    <div className=\"sheet-backdrop\" role=\"presentation\" onMouseDown={(event) => event.target === event.currentTarget && onClose()}>\n      <section ref={modal.ref} onKeyDown={modal.onKeyDown} className=\"bottom-sheet\" role=\"dialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-labelledby=\"sheet-title\">\n        <header><h2 id=\"sheet-title\">{title}</h2><button type=\"button\" className=\"icon-button\" onClick={onClose} aria-label={text('閉じる', '关闭')}><X aria-hidden=\"true\" /></button></header>\n        <div className=\"bottom-sheet__body\">{children}</div>\n      </section>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n\nexport function ConfirmDialog({ open, title, body, confirmLabel, onConfirm, onCancel }: { open: boolean; title: string; body: string; confirmLabel: string; onConfirm: () => void; onCancel: () => void }) {\n  const { text } = useI18n()\n  const modal = useModalFocus(open, onCancel)\n  if (!open) return null\n  return (\n    <div className=\"dialog-backdrop\">\n      <section ref={modal.ref} onKeyDown={modal.onKeyDown} className=\"confirm-dialog\" role=\"alertdialog\" aria-modal=\"true\" aria-labelledby=\"confirm-title\" aria-describedby=\"confirm-body\">\n        <h2 id=\"confirm-title\">{title}</h2><p id=\"confirm-body\">{body}</p>\n        <div className=\"button-row\"><button type=\"button\" className=\"text-button\" onClick={onCancel}>{text('キャンセル', '取消')}</button><RaisedButton onClick={onConfirm}>{confirmLabel}</RaisedButton></div>\n      </section>\n    </div>\n  )\n}\n"

      "source": "export function stripTextbookMarkdown(value: string) {\n  return value\n    .replace(/\\*\\*([^*]+)\\*\\*/g, '$1')\n    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, '$1')\n    .trim()\n}\n\nfunction normalizeSubscriptSequence(value: string) {\n  const map: Record<string, string> = {\n    '₀':'0','₁':'1','₂':'2','₃':'3','₄':'4','₅':'5','₆':'6','₇':'7','₈':'8','₉':'9',\n    'ₓ':'x','ᵧ':'y','ₜ':'t',\n  }\n  return [...value].map((char) => map[char] ?? char).join('')\n}\n\nfunction normalizeUnicodeRadicals(value: string) {\n  let result = ''\n  let index = 0\n\n  while (index < value.length) {\n    if (value[index] !== '√') {\n      result += value[index]\n      index += 1\n      continue\n    }\n\n    if (value[index + 1] === '(') {\n      let depth = 0\n      let closingIndex = -1\n\n      for (let cursor = index + 1; cursor < value.length; cursor += 1) {\n        if (value[cursor] === '(') depth += 1\n        if (value[cursor] === ')') {\n          depth -= 1\n          if (depth === 0) {\n            closingIndex = cursor\n            break\n          }\n        }\n      }\n\n      if (closingIndex !== -1) {\n        const radicand = value.slice(index + 2, closingIndex)\n        result += `\\\\sqrt{${normalizeUnicodeRadicals(radicand)}}`\n        index = closingIndex + 1\n        continue\n      }\n    }\n\n    const unwrapped = value.slice(index + 1).match(/^([A-Za-z0-9Δθ⃗̄₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉ₓᵧₜ²³_]+)/)\n    if (unwrapped) {\n      result += `\\\\sqrt{${unwrapped[1]}}`\n      index += unwrapped[1].length + 1\n      continue\n    }\n\n    result += '√'\n    index += 1\n  }\n\n  return result\n}\n\nexport function normalizeTextbookMath(value: string) {\n  let next = stripTextbookMarkdown(value)\n\n  // Plain finite-set literals like {1,4} need escaped TeX braces.\n  // Never reinterpret grouping braces used by LaTeX commands (\\\\overline{A},\n  // \\\\sqrt{2}, \\\\frac{a}{b}, etc.) or superscripts/subscripts as sets.\n  next = next.replace(/\\{([\\-0-9A-Za-z,+\\s]+)\\}/g, (match, members: string, offset: number, source: string) => {\n    const before = source.slice(0, offset)\n    if (before.endsWith('\\\\') || /\\\\[A-Za-z]+\\*?$/.test(before) || /[_^]$/.test(before)) return match\n    // A two-argument TeX command has a second group after the first closing brace.\n    if (/\\\\[A-Za-z]+\\*?\\{[^{}]*\\}$/.test(before)) return match\n    return `\\\\{${members}\\\\}`\n  })\n  next = normalizeUnicodeRadicals(next)\n\n  next = next\n    .replace(/overline\\(([^()]*)\\)/g, '\\\\overline{$1}')\n    .replace(/\\s*∩\\s*/g, ' \\\\cap ')\n    .replace(/\\s*∪\\s*/g, ' \\\\cup ')\n    .replace(/\\s*∈\\s*/g, ' \\\\in ')\n    .replace(/\\s*∉\\s*/g, ' \\\\notin ')\n    .replace(/Δ([A-Za-z])⃗([₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉ₓᵧₜ]+)/g, (_, base: string, sub: string) => `\\\\Delta \\\\vec{${base}}_{${normalizeSubscriptSequence(sub)}}`)\n    .replace(/([A-Za-z])⃗([₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉ₓᵧₜ]+)/g, (_, .replace(/tan/g, '\\\\tan ')\n\n  return next.trim()\n}\n\nexport function looksLikeTextbookMath(value: string) {\n  const text = stripTextbookMarkdown(value)\n  if (!text || /[ぁ-んァ-ヶ一-龠]/.test(text)) return false\n  if (/[=+\\-−×÷/√²³⃗θΔ°()₀₁₂₃₄₅₆₇₈₉ₓᵧₜ_∩∪∈∉]/.test(text)) return true\n  if (/overline\\(/.test(text) || /^\\{[^{}]+\\}$/.test(text)) return true\n  if (/(?:sin|cos|tan)/.test(text))       "usedByRendererBundle": true,
      "source": "import { mathFractionDisplayValue } from './mathFractionDisplay'\nimport { neDevelopmentDisplayLines } from './neDevelopmentDisplay'\nimport { n12CostDisplayLines } from './n12CostDisplay'\n\n/**\n * Display-only row layout for approved staged math derivations.\n * Canonical answers, comparison signs and grading strings never change.\n */\nexport function textbookDisplayLines(itemId: string, value: string): string[] {\n  const developmentLines = neDevelopmentDisplayLines(itemId, value)\n  if (developmentLines) return developmentLines.map(line => mathFractionDisplayValue(itemId, line))\n  // P-004-R3: one specific long original-source choice, three independent facts.\n  // Visual line breaks only; grading, stored answer and other items are unchanged.\n  if (itemId === 'n07-09') return value.split(',\\\\;')\n  // P-004-R4: three operation-and-result choices wrap only on presentation.\n  if (['n11-13', 'n14-14', 'n14-15'].includes(itemId)) return value.split(',\\\\quad')\n  // W-MATH-011/P-001: five proof decisions show sign/reason on separate rows.\n  if (['n11-wm011-q02-compare', 'n11-wm011-q03-positive', 'n11-03',\n    'n11-wm011-q03-zero', 'n11-wm011-q04-fraction'].includes(itemId)) return value.split(',\\\\quad')\n  // P-004-R5: one cognitive operation plus one justified result per item.\n  if (['n06-15', 'n08-10', 'n13-08'].includes(itemId)) return value.split(',\\\\quad')\n  if (itemId === 'n09-08') {\n    // Cover correct and distractor options, preserving the exact comparison operators.\n    const match = /^1\\.41\\^2=(\\d+\\.\\d+)([<>])2([<>])(\\d+\\.\\d+)=1\\.42\\^2$/.exec(value)\n    if (match) {\n      const [, left, leftSign, rightSign, right] = match\n      return [`1.41^2=${left}`, `${left}${leftSign}2${rightSign}${right}`, `${right}=1.42^2`]\n    }\n  }\n  return n12CostDisplayLines(itemId, mathFractionDisplayValue(itemId, value))\n}\n\n"

      "source": "import type { TextbookReadingBlock } from '../../../domain/textbookSchema'\n\n// Math I+A, published \"集合\": presentation metadata ONLY.\n// Every source block is rendered from the original readingFlow. No lesson copy, answer,\n// new math statement, figure, or unit revision is stored here.\nexport type MathSetReadingStage = {\n  id: string\n  label: { ja: string; zh: string }\n  startBlockId: string\n}\n\nexport type MathSetRenderedStage = MathSetReadingStage & {\n  blocks: readonly TextbookReadingBlock[]\n}\n\nexport const mathSetReadingStages: readonly MathSetReadingStage[] = [\n  { id: 'gather', label: { ja: '集合と要素', zh: '集合与元素' }, startBlockId: 'heading-represent' },\n  { id: 'membership', label: { ja: '要素の所属', zh: '元素的归属' }, startBlockId: 'dialogue-teacher-membership' },\n  { id: 'builder', label: { ja: '集合の表し方', zh: '集合的表示' }, startBlockId: 'marker-example-builder' },\n  { id: 'finite', label: { ja: '有限集合と無限集合', zh: '有限集与无限集' }, startBlockId: 'paragraph-a08b' },\n  { id: 'intersection', label: { ja: '共通部分', zh: '交集' }, startBlockId: 'heading-relations' },\n  { id: 'union', label: { ja: '和集合', zh: '并集' }, startBlockId: 'paragraph-b03' },\n  { id: 'subset', label: { ja: '部分集合', zh: '子集' }, startBlockId: 'marker-example-subset' },\n  { id: 'empty-set', label: { ja: '空集合と部分集合', zh: '空集与子集' }, startBlockId: 'paragraph-c04' },\n  { id: 'complement', label: { ja: '全体集合と補集合', zh: '全集与补集' }, startBlockId: 'heading-outside' },\n  { id: 'complement-laws', label: { ja: '補集合の関係', zh: '补集的关系' }, startBlockId: 'paragraph-d03' },\n  { id: 'de-morgan', label: { ja: 'ド・モルガンの法則', zh: '德摩根定律' }, startBlockId: 'marker-example-demorgan' },\n  { id: 'check-de-morgan', label: { ja: '法則を要素で確認', zh: '用元素验证定律' }, startBlockId: 'marker-check-demorgan' },\n  { id: 'real-line', label: { ja: '実数と数直線', zh: '实数与数轴' }, startBlockId: 'marker-example-real-line' },\n  { id: 'real-line-operations', label: { ja: '数直線上の集合の関係', zh: '数轴上的集合关系' }, startBlockId: 'paragraph-f07' },\n  { id: 'summary', label: { ja: '集合のまとめ', zh: '集合小结' }, startBlockId: 'marker-summary-sets' },\n]\n\n// Exact prerequisite source blocks for each active question. These blocks are part\n// of the original lesson and were already learned in an earlier presentation stage.\n// Unlike stage-wide references, this map cannot expose unrelated formulae just\n// because another question within the same stage needs them.\n// Missing entry means the question needs no cross-stage reference.\nexport const mathSetRequiredContextByItemId: Readonly<Record<string, readonly ['paragraph-subset-concept'],\n  'set-d03': ['paragraph-universal-concept', 'formula-d-b'],\n  'set-d04': ['formula-d-a', 'formula-d-b'],\n  'set-d05': ['formula-d-a', 'formula-d-b'],\n  'set-d06': ['formula-d-abar', 'formula-d-b'],\n  'set-d07': ['formula-d-abar', 'formula-d-b'],\n  'set-d08': ['paragraph-universal-concept', 'formula-d-a', 'formula-d-abar', 'figure-d-complement'],\n  'set-d09': ['paragraph-universal-concept', 'formula-d-a', 'formula-d-abar', 'figure-d-complement'],\n  'set-d10': ['paragraph-universal-concept', 'formula-d-a', 'formula-d-abar', 'figure-d-complement'],\n 'set-e13': ['formula-e-laws'],\n  'set-e14': ['formula-e-laws'],\n  'set-f07': ['formula-f-sets', 'figure-f-b'],\n  'set-f08': ['formula-f-sets', 'figure-f-b'],\n  'set-f09': ['formula-f-sets'],\n  'set-f10': ['formula-f-sets'],\n  'set-f11': ['formula-f-sets'],\n  'set-f12': ['formula-f-sets'],\n  'set-f13': ['formula-f-sets'],\n}\n\nexport function requiredMathSetContext(itemId: string | null): readonly string[] {\n  return itemId ? (mathSetRequiredContextByItemId[itemId] ?? []) : []\n}\n\nexport function partitionMathSetReadingFlow(blocks: readonly TextbookReadingBlock[]): MathSetRenderedStage[] {\n  if (!blocks.length) throw new Error('math-sets readingFlow must not be empty')\n  const ids = new Map<string, number>()\n  for (const [index, block] of blocks.entries()) {\n    if (ids.has(block.id)) throw new Error('duplicate math-sets reading block: ' + block.id)\n    ids.set(block.id, index)\n  }\n  const starts = mathSetReadingStages.map(stage => {\n    const index = ids.get(stage.startBlockId)\n    if (index === undefined) throw new Error('missing math-sets stage anchor: ' + stage.startBlockId)\n    return index\n  })\n  if (starts[0] !== 0 || starts.some((index, i) => i > 0 && index <= starts[i - 1])) {\n    throw new Error('math-sets stages must form a strictly ordered complete partition')\n  }\n\n  const stages = mathSetReadingStages.map((stage, index): MathSetRenderedStage => ({\n    ...stage,\n    blocks: blocks.slice(starts[index], starts[index + 1] ?? blocks.length),\n  }))\n  const previousStageForBlock = new Map<string, number>()\n  for (const [index, stage] of stages.entries()) {\n    for (const block of stage.blocks) previousStageForBlock.set(block.id, index)\n    const next = stages[index + 1]?.blocks[0]\n    const last = stage.blocks[stage.blocks.length - 1]\n    // A continuous derivation must NEVER be cut into two separately hidden stages.\n    if (last && next &&\n        (last.type === 'paragraph' || last.type === 'formula' || last.type === 'note') &&\n        (next.type === 'paragraph' || next.type === 'formula' || next.type === 'note') &&\n        last.derivationId && last.derivationId === next.derivationId) {\n      throw new Error('math-sets stage cuts a derivation chain: ' + last.derivationId)\n    }\n  }\n  // Fail closed if a prerequisite refers to a missing/future block or a question\n  // outside the source lesson; this also guards against accidental answer leakage.\n  const stageForItem = new Map<string, number>()\n  for (const [index, stage] of stages.entries()) {\n    for (const block of stage.blocks) {\n      if (block.type === 'paragraph' || block.type === 'formula') {\n        for (const part of block.parts) {\n          if (part.type === 'choice') stageForItem.set(part.itemId, index)\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  for (const [itemId, refs] of Object.entries(mathSetRequiredContextByItemId)) {\n    const stageIndex = stageForItem.get(itemId)\n    if (stageIndex === undefined) throw new Error('math-sets prerequisite target does not exist: ' + itemId)\n    if (new Set(refs).size !== refs.length) throw new Error('math-sets duplicate prerequisite: ' + itemId)\n    for (const ref of refs) {\n      const sourceStage = previousStageForBlock.get(ref)\n      if (sourceStage === undefined || sourceStage >= stageIndex) {\n        throw new Error('math-sets prerequisite must be from a completed earlier stage: ' + itemId + ' / ' + ref)\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  if (stages.reduce((n, stage) => n + stage.blocks.length, 0) !== blocks.length) {\n    throw new Error('math-sets stage coverage is incomplete')\n  }\n  return stages\n}\n"

      "source": "import type { TextbookReadingBlock } from '../../domain/textbookSchema'\n\ntype FormulaBlock = Extract<TextbookReadingBlock, { type: 'formula' }>\n\n// Keep operators with the following term; never split a brace, radical, fraction,\n// parenthesized factor or interactive coefficient. Only audited blocks opt in.\nexport function formulaWrapChunks(block: FormulaBlock): string[] {\n  const source = block.parts.map((part, index) => part.type === 'math'\n    ? part.latex : part.type === 'choice' ? `§${index}§` : '').join('')\n  const chunks: string[] = []\n  let start = 0, braces = 0, parentheses = 0, absolute = false\n  const push = (end: number) => { if (end > start) chunks.push(source.slice(start, end)); start = end }\n  for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i++) {\n    const char = source[i]\n    if (char === '\\\\') {\n      const command = source.slice(i).match(/^\\\\[A-Za-z]+/)?.[0] ?? source.slice(i, i + 2)\n      if (!braces && !parentheses && !absolute) {\n        if (/^\\\\(?:Longrightarrow|longrightarrow)$/.test(command)) {\n          push(i); push(i + command.length)\n        } else if ((command === '\\\\qquad' || (block.id === 'formula-n03-01' && /^\\\\(?:times|cdot)$/.test(command)) || /^\\\\(?:le|ge|lt|gt)$/.test(command)) && i > start) push(i)\n      }\n      i += command.length - 1\n      continue\n    }\n    if (char === '{') braces++\n    if (char === '}') braces--\n    if (braces) continue\n    if (char === '(')       "source": "/**\n * Scope: the four confirmed textbook items only.       "usedByRendererBundle": true,
      "source": "/**\n * W-MATH-008/P-001: split only the two long N12 cost-model answers for\n * presentation. The canonical answer and scoring strings stay unchanged.\n * Every fragment is independent valid KaTeX (never split a TeX command).\n */\nexport function n12CostDisplayLines(itemId: string, value: string): string[] {\n  if (itemId === 'n12-10' || itemId === 'n12-11') {\n    const breakAt = value.lastIndexOf('+130(')\n    if (breakAt > 0) {\n      return [value.slice(0, breakAt), value.slice(breakAt)]\n    }\n  }\n  if (itemId === 'n12-15') {\n    const breakAt = value.indexOf(',\\\\ ')\n    if (breakAt > 0) return [value.slice(0, breakAt), value.slice(breakAt + 3)]\n  }\n  return [value]\n}\n"

{q:8,lead:'両端の平方と中央の項がすべて一致した。和の平方に戻そう。',expr:'16x^2+24xy+9y^2',prompt:'因数分解を完成させよう。',answer:'(4x+3y)^2',wrong:['(4x-3y)^2','(4x+3y)(4x-3y)','(16x+9y)^2'],hint:'中央が正なので同じ和の括弧を二つ使う。',after:'中央の符号まで含めて照合することが、公式の逆利用では欠かせない。'},\n {q:4,lead:'置換の定義X=x+2yを両方の因数へ戻そう。',expr:'(X-3)(X+2)',prompt:'元の文字だけで積を書こう。',answer:'(x+2y-3)(x+2y+2)',wrong:['(x+2y-3)(X+2)','(x+2y+3)(x+2y-2)','(x-2y-3)(x-2y+2)'],hint:'Xをどちらの括弧からもなくす。',after:'置換は途中の計算を短くするための仮の名前である。'},\n {q:5,lead:'分母nで割るとき、余りは0からn−1までしかない。余り0にならず無限に割り続けたら、何が必ず起こるだろう。',prompt:'余りが繰り返す理由を選ぼう。',kind:'text',answer:'0以外の余りは有限種類なので同じ余りが再び現れる',wrong:['商の数字は必ず0か1だけになる','余りはいつまでも違う数へ増え続ける','余りが0でなければ分数は無理数になる'],hint:'0以外の余りにはn−1種類しかない。計算は何度でも続く。',after:'同じ余りへ戻れば、その後の商の列も繰り返す。余り0なら有限小数、そうでなければ循環小数になる。'},\n {q:6,lead:'x=0.8888…と置く。10、100、1000倍した小数を比べ、繰り返す小数部分が元のxとそろう最小の倍率を探そう。',expr:'x=0.\\\\overline8',prompt:'繰り返す部分がそろう最小の倍率と、掛けた後の小数を選ぼう。',answer:'10\\\\text{倍},\\\\quad10x=8.\\\\overline8',wrong:['100\\\\text{倍},\\\\quad100x=88.\\\\overline8','10\\\\text{倍},\\\\quad10x=0.\\\\overline8','10\\\\text{倍},\\\\quad10x=8.8'],hint:'小数点を何桁ずらすと、元のxと同じ繰り返し部分になる？最も小さい倍率を選ぶ。',after:'一桁周期なので最小倍率は10。10x=8.888…とx=0.888…の小数部分がそろう。'},\n       "source": "import { validateTextbookUnits } from '../../../../domain/textbookSchema'\nimport { oneToOneSourceMap } from './reviewLessonHelpers'\nimport { makeReviewSteps } from intro:'数直線で位置の向きと距離を切り離して考える。左側の点でも、長さとしての距離は負にならない。',\n    steps:[\n      {q:1,lead:'元図の2.3と−5は、それぞれ原点の右と左にある。原点までの距離をこの順に比べる。',expr:'2.3,\\\\quad-5',prompt:'二点から原点までの距離を選ぼう。',answer:'2.3,\\\\quad5',wrong:['2.3,\\\\quad-5','-2.3,\\\\quad5','2.3,\\\\quad-5.0'],hint:'距離は原点からどれだけ離れているか。マイナスの向きは距離そのものではない。',after:'実数aの点と原点との距離を絶対値といい、|a|と書く。'},\n       "usedByRendererBundle": false,
      "source": "// Shared authoring primitives for the approved W-MATH-003 review lessons.\n// Source-to-item IDs and answers belong to the authoring layer, not learner copy.\nexport const T = (text: string) => ({ type: 'text' as const, text })\nexport const M = (latex: string) => ({ type: 'math' as const, latex })\nexport const C = (itemId: string) => ({ type: 'choice' as const, itemId })\nexport const K = (text: string) => ({ type: 'term' as const, text })\n\ntype Purpose = 'concept-formation' | 'representation-link' | 'transfer' | 'causal-reasoning' | 'graph-reading'\ntype Level = 'strong' | 'medium' | 'light'\ntype Kind = 'formula' | 'text'\n\nexport function reviewItem(\n  id: string, prompt: string, answer: string, answerType: Kind,\n  distractors: [string, string, ...string[]], purpose: Purpose, scaffoldLevel: Level,\n  hints: string[] = [],\n) {\n  return {\n    id, label: id.toUpperCase(), prompt, answer, acceptedAnswers: [], answerType,\n    choices: [answer, ...distractors], purpose, scaffoldLevel, hints,\n  }\n}\n\nexport function oneToOneSourceMap(prefix: 'N02' | 'N03' | 'N04' | 'N05' | 'N06' | 'N07' | 'N08' | 'N09' | 'N10' | 'N11' | 'N12' | 'N13' | 'N14', count: number) {\n  return Object.fromEntries(\n    Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => {\n      const n = String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')\n      return [prefix + '-Q' + n, [prefix.toLowerCase() + '-' + n]]\n    }),\n  ) as Record<string, string[]>\n}"

      "usedByRendererBundle": false,
      "source": "import type { TextbookItem, TextbookReadingBlock } from '../../../../domain/textbookSchema'\nimport { T, M, C, reviewItem } from './reviewLessonHelpers'\n\n/**\n * W-MATH-003/P-003-R1: each original Word marker is one authored reasoning node.\n * N04-Q01 keeps its previously approved four local products plus source result.\n * This helper arranges human-written questions, explanations and answer-gated images;\n * it does NOT calculate answers or synthesize distractors.\n */\nexport type GuidedStep = {\n  q: number\n  lead: string\n  expr?: string\n  exprLines?: string[]\n  stem?: string\n  prompt: string\n  answer: string\n  wrong: [string, string, string]\n  hint: string\n  after: string\n  kind?: 'text' | 'formula'\n}\n\nexport type GuidedGroup = {\n  title: string\n  intro: string\n  marker?: 'example' | 'check' | 'proof'\n  steps: GuidedStep[]\n}\n\nexport type FigurePlacement = { id: string; q: number; when: 'before' | 'after' }\n\nexport function makeReviewSteps(\n  prefix: string,\n  groups: GuidedGroup[],\n  figures: FigurePlacement[] = [],\n): { readingFlow: TextbookReadingBlock[]; items: TextbookItem[] } {\n  const readingFlow: TextbookReadingBlock[] = []\n  const items: TextbookItem[] = []\n  const total = groups.reduce((sum, group) => sum + group.steps.length, 0)\n  let ordinal = 0\n  const seen = new Set<number>()\n  for (const [groupIndex, group] of groups.entries()) {\n    readingFlow.push({\n      id: prefix + '-heading-' + (groupIndex + 1),\n      type: 'heading', text: group.title,\n    })\n    readingFlow.push({\n      id: prefix + '-marker-' + (groupIndex + 1),\n      type: 'marker', kind: group.marker ?? (groupIndex === 0 ? 'example' : 'check'),\n      text: group.marker === 'proof' ? '導出' : groupIndex === 0 ? '例題' : '確認',\n    })\n    readingFlow.push({\n      id: prefix + '-group-' + (groupIndex + 1),\n      type: 'paragraph', parts: [T(group.intro)],\n    })\n    for (const step of group.steps) {\n      if (seen.has(step.q)) throw new Error(prefix + ': duplicated original marker Q' + step.q)\n      seen.add(step.q)\n      const q = String(step.q).padStart(2, '0')\n      const id = prefix + '-' + q\n      for (const f of figures.filter(f => f.q === step.q && f.when === 'before'))\n        readingFlow.push({ id: prefix + '-show-' + f.id, type: 'figure', figureId: f.id })\n      readingFlow.push({\n        id: prefix + '-lead-' + q, type: 'paragraph',\n        parts: step.expr ? [T(step.lead), M(step.expr)] : [T(step.lead)],\n      })\n      for (const [lineIndex, latex] of (step.exprLines ?? []).entries()) {\n        readingFlow.push({ id: prefix + '-source-' + q + '-' + (lineIndex + 1), type: 'formula', parts: [M(latex)] })\n      }\n      readingFlow.push({\n        id: prefix + '-formula-' + q,\n        type: step.kind === 'text' ? 'paragraph' : 'formula',\n        parts: step.kind === 'text' ? [T('考えて選ぶ：'), C(id)] : step.stem ? [M(step.stem), C(id)] : [C(id)],\n      })\n      readingFlow.push({\n        id: prefix + '-after-' + q,\n        type: 'paragraph', parts: [T(step.after)],\n      })\n      for (const f of figures.filter(f => f.q === step.q && f.when === 'after'))\n        readingFlow.push({ id: prefix + '-show-' + f.id, type: 'figure', figureId: f.id })\n      const level = ordinal < 2 ? 'strong' : ordinal < Math.floor(total * 0.7) ? 'medium' : 'light'\n      const purpose = ordinal === 0 ? 'concept-formation' : ordinal < Math.floor(total * 0.7) ? 'causal-reasoning' : 'transfer'\n      items.push(reviewItem(id, step.prompt, step.answer, step.kind ?? 'formula', step.wrong, purpose, level, [step.hint]))\n      ordinal += 1\n    }\n  }\n  return { readingFlow, items }\n}\n"

tools/textbook/tests/n08-transformation.test.mjs
import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import fs from 'node:fs';
import {n08TransformationPlan} from '../transformation/n08.mjs';
import {validateTransformationPlan} from '../transformation/validate.mjs';
import {compileTransformationPresentation} from '../transformation/compile.mjs';
import {projectTransformationView} from '../transformation/visible.mjs';
const ir=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n08Revision5.json')),plan=n08TransformationPlan(ir),clone=v=>JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
const result=compileTransformationPresentation(ir,plan);assert.equal(result.status,'PASS');
test('four source-bound groups, eleven unchanged grading interactions and two meaning overrides',()=>{
 assert.equal(plan.groups.length,4);assert.equal(plan.candidates.length,11);assert.equal(plan.proseOverrides.length,2);assert.deepEqual(plan.groups.map(g=>g.number),[13,17,20,23]);
 assert.deepEqual(clone(result.compiled),JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n08Transformation.json')));
});
test('old source, original figure, grading and N11 display remain byte-identical',()=>{
 const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('work/items/W-MATH-039-n08-grouped-transformations/PROTECTED_MANIFEST.json'));
 const {createHash}=requireCrypto();for(const [path,digest]of Object.entries(manifest)){
  if(path==='src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n08ActiveVersion.json'&&JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path)).revision===7){
   const r7=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n08Revision7.json'));assert.equal(r7.unit.revision,7);assert.equal(r7.unit.requiredInteractionRefs.length,30);assert.equal(r7.unit.constructionItems.length,6);assert.equal(r7.unit.constructionItemsV2.length,14);assert.equal(r7.unit.sections[0].items.length,10);assert.equal(r7.unit.constructionItems.reduce((n,i)=>n+i.parts.length,0)+r7.unit.constructionItemsV2.reduce((n,i)=>n+i.parts.length,0)+10,42);continue; // Approved W041/P001: pointer only; all protected original bytes are still checked.
  }
  if(path==='src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n08ActiveVersion.json'&&JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path)).revision===6){
   const r6=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n08Revision6.json'));assert.equal(r6.unit.revision,6);assert.equal(r6.unit.requiredInteractionRefs.length,33);assert.equal(r6.unit.constructionItems.length,11);continue; // W040 explicitly changes only the active pointer; immutable W039 manifest is retained.
  }
  // W047 explicitly replaced N11 after W039. Keep the immutable old manifest,
  // recognize only the accepted r11 edition, and retain the strict fallback below.
  const n11Path='src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n11Authored.json',n11DisplayPath='src/data/textbook/math/numbers/n11Transformation.json';
  if((path===n11Path||path===n11DisplayPath)&&JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(n11Path)).unit.revision===11){
   assert.equal(manifest[n11Path],'ae3823163ac23bb334ac02a6c868bbd1273b8b6f1f65c77cde6f751773900a74');
   assert.equal(manifest[n11DisplayPath],'c1cbfd5c5e4b7ee79baf40cd54a9170c4cae5286fb04e940c5f50e92bc3f5197');
   const source=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(n11Path)),display=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(n11DisplayPath));
   assert.equal(source.unit.unitId,'math-numbers-expressions-n11');
   assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(n11Path)).digest('hex'),'3465df01e4d764a6aae14742b370804494450055205c968685715c9157cb10fe');
   assert.equal(createHash('sha256').update(fs.readFileSync(n11DisplayPath)).digest('hex'),'906c4fef2e53a9a992fae5f82e7a7255a504215eeee19954f179d2fa902707a9');
   assert.equal(display.baseIRHash,'3465df01e4d764a6aae14742b370804494450055205c968685715c9157cb10fe');

import copy,json,tempfile,unittest
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from contracts import manifest
from legacy_diagnostics import inspect,PATH,SOURCE
from store import digest
from views import snapshot
from tools.textbook.corpus.scoped_catalog import scoped_catalog

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
class LegacyDiagnostics(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();self.root=Path(self.tmp.name)
        self.data=json.loads(__import__('subprocess').check_output(['git','show',SOURCE+':'+PATH],cwd=ROOT));p=self.root/PATH;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True);p.write_text(json.dumps(self.data))
        self.plan={'command':'CMD-WORK-001','source_sha':SOURCE,'source_manifest':manifest(self.root,[PATH])}
        self.rt=SimpleNamespace(root=self.root,state=lambda _: {'plan':self.plan})
    def tearDown(self):self.tmp.cleanup()
    def test_actual_legacy_diagnosis_does_not_certify_readiness(self):
        r=inspect(self.rt,'test',self.data,visible=True)
        self.assertEqual(r['status'],'NEEDS_AI_REVIEW');self.assertEqual(r['lessonReadiness'],'NOT_READY')
        self.assertFalse(r['productionIRValidated']);self.assertEqual(len(r['visibleStates']),41)
        self.assertTrue(all(not n['afterVisible'] for n in r['visibleStates']));self.assertTrue(r['findings'])
    def test_source_mismatch_cannot_bypass(self):
        d=copy.deepcopy(self.data);d['nodes'][0]['before']='edited';self.assertEqual(inspect(self.rt,'test',d)['status'],'FAIL')
        (self.root/PATH).write_text('{}');self.assertEqual(inspect(self.rt,'test',self.data)['status'],'FAIL')
    def test_only_registered_source_and_correction_format(self):
        for key,value in [('command','CMD-WORK-002'),('source_sha','a'*40)]:
            p=dict(self.plan);self.plan[key]=value;self.assertIsNone(inspect(self.rt,'test',self.data));self.plan=p
        d=dict(self.data,schemaVersion='production-ir/1');self.assertIsNone(inspect(self.rt,'test',d))

class CatalogFallback(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.cases=json.loads((ROOT/'work/items/W-GOV-010-learning-production-workflow/redesign/implementation/CURATED_CASES.json').read_text())['cases']
        self.data={'cases':self.cases,'corpusHash':digest(self.cases),'scope':{'subject':'math','mode':'textbook'},'mandatoryInputs':['F01','F02','F03','F04','F05','F06']}
    def test_all_scoped_cases_and_mandatory_findings_retained(self):
        r=scoped_catalog(self.data,'encoder unavailable');self.assertFalse(r['ranked']);self.assertFalse(r['modelRan'])
        self.assertEqual(len(r['hits']),len(self.cases));self.assertEqual(len(r['mandatoryInputs']),6)
    def test_corrupt_hash_or_incomplete_evidence_is_failure(self):
        d=copy.deepcopy(self.data);d['corpusHash']='bad'
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):scoped_catalog(d,'unavailable')
        d=copy.deepcopy(self.data);d['cases'][0]['artifactVersion']='';d['corpusHash']=digest(d['cases'])
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):scoped_catalog(d,'unavailable')
    def test_other_mode_not_retrieved(self):
        self.data['scope']['mode']='practice';self.assertEqual(scoped_catalog(self.data,'unavailable')['hits'],[])

class MaterializationBinding(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        from runtime import Runtime
        self.tmp=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory();self.rt=Runtime(Path(self.tmp.name)/'ledger',ROOT)
        self.plan=json.loads((ROOT/'work/items/W-MATH-032-n07-semantic-repair/WORKFLOW_PLAN.json').read_text());self.plan['simulation']=True;self.plan['source_manifest']=manifest(ROOT,self.plan['source_manifest'])
        # This is a current-root simulation, not a rewrite of the historical Work/approval.
        self.historical_protected_manifest=copy.deepcopy(self.plan['protected_manifest'])
        self.plan['protected_manifest']=manifest(ROOT,self.plan['protected_manifest'])
        self.rt.open(self.plan);self.work=self.plan['work_id']
        self.ev=self.rt.evidence(self.work,'file',{'path':PATH,'sha256':manifest(ROOT,[PATH])[PATH]},source_ref='simulation:binding-test',verification_level='simulation')
    def tearDown(self):self.tmp.cleanup()
    def test_historical_protected_manifest_still_rejected(self):
        from runtime import Runtime
        from contracts import Rejected
        historical=copy.deepcopy(self.plan)
        historical['protected_manifest']=copy.deepcopy(self.historical_protected_manifest)
        self.assertNotEqual(historical['protected_manifest'],self.plan['protected_manifest'])
        rejected=Runtime(Path(self.tmp.name)/'historical-protection-ledger',ROOT)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(Rejected,'保護対象の固定版が違う'):
            rejected.open(historical)
        self.assertEqual(list(rejected.store.events()),[])
    def test_binding_requires_approval_and_preserves_its_identity(self):
        from materialization import bind_n07
        from contracts import Rejected
        with self.assertRaises(Rejected):bind_n07(self.rt,self.work,'e6fc1017f3ce8f5cdce6102720b32afdc73f652b',[self.ev])
        ref=self.rt.user(self.work,'approve_proposal','simulation only',self.plan['proposal']['hash'],'simulation:binding',verification_level='simulation')
        generated=bind_n07(self.rt,self.work,'e6fc1017f3ce8f5cdce6102720b32afdc73f652b',[self.ev])
        s=self.rt.state(self.work);self.assertEqual(self.rt.approval(s)['id'],ref)
        self.assertEqual(s['plan']['proposal']['hash'],self.plan['proposal']['hash'])
        self.assertTrue(all(b['proposal_hash']==self.plan['proposal']['hash'] for b in s['plan']['approval_bundles']))
        self.assertEqual(s['plan']['proposal']['contentDesignHash'],generated['compiled']['irHash'])
    def test_wrong_approved_commit_rejected(self):
        from materialization import bind_n07
        self.rt.user(self.work,'approve_proposal','simulation only',self.plan['proposal']['hash'],'simulation:binding',verification_level='simulation')
        with self.assertRaises(Exception):bind_n07(self.rt,self.work,'4fb7a98e7f864839ccc1374080473df4ba60ce88',[self.ev])
    def test_patch_binding_rejects_unregistered_paths_and_different_artifact(self):
        from materialization import bind_n07,bind_patch
        from contracts import Rejected
        import hashlib
        self.rt.user(self.work,'approve_proposal','simulation only',self.plan['proposal']['hash'],'simulation:binding',verification_level='simulation')
        g=bind_n07(self.rt,self.work,'e6fc1017f3ce8f5cdce6102720b32afdc73f652b',[self.ev])
        rows=[]
        for path in [PATH,'src/components/textbook/N07ReadingFlow.tsx','src/components/textbook/n07-reading.css']:
            value=json.dumps(g['artifact'],ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n' if path==PATH else (ROOT/path).read_text()
            rows.append({'path':path,'before_sha256':manifest(ROOT,[path])[path],'after_text':value,'after_sha256':hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()})
        delta={'files':rows};ref=bind_patch(self.rt,self.work,delta,[self.ev]);self.assertTrue(ref);self.assertTrue(self.rt.approval(self.rt.state(self.work)))
        bad=copy.deepcopy(delta);bad['files'][0]['path']='other.json'
        with self.assertRaises(Rejected):bind_patch(self.rt,self.work,bad,[self.ev])
        bad=copy.deepcopy(delta);bad['files'][0]['after_text']='{}';bad['files'][0]['after_sha256']=hashlib.sha256(b'{}').hexdigest()
        with self.assertRaises(Rejected):bind_patch(self.rt,self.work,bad,[self.ev])
